export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  // 1. Suppliers
  const supplierRows = SUPPLIERS.map((s, i) => ({
    id: detId('supplier', s.name),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    name: s.name,
    contact_name: s.contact,
    email: s.email,
    phone: s.phone,
    website: `https://${s.name.toLowerCase().replace(/\W+/g, '')}.com`,
    is_active: true,
    notes: `Demo supplier ${i + 1}`,
  }))
  const { error: sErr } = await sb.from('suppliers').upsert(supplierRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (sErr) throw new Error(`[inventory] suppliers upsert: ${sErr.message}`)
  log.module('inventory', supplierRows.length, 'suppliers')
  ctx.supplierIds = supplierRows.map((r) => r.id)

  // 2. Inventory items
  const itemRows = INK_ITEMS.map((it, i) => ({
    id: detId('inventory_item', it.name),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    supplier_id: supplierRows[i % supplierRows.length]!.id,
    location_id: ctx.locations.primary,
    name: it.name,
    sku: `SKU-${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    category: it.cat,
    brand: it.brand,
    color: it.color,
    size: it.size,
    unit: it.cat === 'ink' ? 'bottle' : it.cat === 'needle' ? 'box' : 'unit',
    current_stock: it.stock,
    min_threshold: it.min,
    max_stock: it.min * 4,
    cost_per_unit_cents: it.cost,
    retail_price_cents: it.retail || null,
    is_active: true,
  }))
  const { error: iErr } = await sb.from('inventory_items').upsert(itemRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (iErr) throw new Error(`[inventory] inventory_items upsert: ${iErr.message}`)
  log.module('inventory', itemRows.length, 'inventory_items')
  ctx.inventoryItemIds = itemRows.map((r) => r.id)

  // 3. Inventory movements — purchase + session_use + stocktake history
  type MoveRow = {
    id: string
    studio_id: string
    item_id: string
    qty_delta: number
    qty_after: number
    reason: 'purchase' | 'session_use' | 'adjustment' | 'waste' | 'return' | 'stocktake' | 'other'
    notes: string | null
    performed_by: string
    created_at: string
  }
  const movements: MoveRow[] = []
  let moveIdx = 0
  for (const item of itemRows) {
    let running = item.current_stock
    // Initial purchase to fill stock
    const initial = item.current_stock + faker.number.int({ min: 4, max: 10 })
    movements.push({
      id: detId('inv_move', `${item.id}:${moveIdx++}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      item_id: item.id,
      qty_delta: initial,
      qty_after: initial,
      reason: 'purchase',
      notes: 'Opening stock purchase',
      performed_by: DEMO_USERS.recept1.id,
      created_at: new Date(Date.now() - 45 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
    })
    // 2-3 session_use entries
    const useCount = faker.number.int({ min: 2, max: 3 })
    running = initial
    for (let u = 0; u < useCount; u++) {
      const delta = -faker.number.int({ min: 1, max: 3 })
      running += delta
      movements.push({
        id: detId('inv_move', `${item.id}:${moveIdx++}`),
        studio_id: ctx.studioId,
        item_id: item.id,
        qty_delta: delta,
        qty_after: running,
        reason: 'session_use',
        notes: 'Session consumption',
        performed_by: DEMO_USERS.artist1.id,
        created_at: new Date(Date.now() - (30 - u * 5) * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      })
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < movements.length; i += 100) {
    const chunk = movements.slice(i, i + 100)
    const { error } = await sb.from('inventory_movements').upsert(chunk, { onConflict: 'id' })
    if (error) throw new Error(`[inventory] inventory_movements upsert chunk ${i}: ${error.message}`)
  }
  log.module('inventory', movements.length, 'inventory_movements')

  // 4. Stock alerts for low / out-of-stock items
  const lowItems = itemRows.filter((it) => it.current_stock <= it.min_threshold)
  const alertRows = lowItems.map((it) => ({
    id: detId('stock_alert', it.id),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    item_id: it.id,
    alert_type: it.current_stock === 0 ? ('out_of_stock' as const) : ('low_stock' as const),
    threshold_value: it.min_threshold,
    current_value: it.current_stock,
    notes: `Re-order needed from supplier`,
  }))
  const { error: aErr } = await sb.from('stock_alerts').upsert(alertRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (aErr) throw new Error(`[inventory] stock_alerts upsert: ${aErr.message}`)
  log.module('inventory', alertRows.length, 'stock_alerts')

  // 5. Purchase orders — 1 received + 1 ordered
  const poRows = [
    {
      id: detId('purchase_order', 'po-1'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      supplier_id: supplierRows[0]!.id,
      order_number: 'PO-2026-0001',
      status: 'received' as const,
      ordered_at: new Date(Date.now() - 14 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      expected_delivery_at: new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      received_at: new Date(Date.now() - 6 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      total_cents: 42000,
      notes: 'Monthly ink restock',
    },
    {
      id: detId('purchase_order', 'po-2'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      supplier_id: supplierRows[1]!.id,
      order_number: 'PO-2026-0002',
      status: 'ordered' as const,
      ordered_at: new Date(Date.now() - 3 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      expected_delivery_at: new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      total_cents: 28000,
      notes: 'Needle cartridges + aftercare',
    },
  ]
  const { error: pErr } = await sb.from('purchase_orders').upsert(poRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (pErr) throw new Error(`[inventory] purchase_orders upsert: ${pErr.message}`)
  log.module('inventory', poRows.length, 'purchase_orders')

  // 6. PO lines — 3 per PO
  const poLines = poRows.flatMap((po, poIdx) =>
    itemRows.slice(poIdx * 3, poIdx * 3 + 3).map((it, li) => ({
      id: detId('po_line', `${po.id}:${li}`),
      purchase_order_id: po.id,
      item_id: it.id,
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      qty_ordered: 10,
      qty_received: po.status === 'received' ? 10 : 0,
      unit_cost_cents: it.cost_per_unit_cents,
      notes: null,
    })),
  )
  const { error: plErr } = await sb.from('purchase_order_lines').upsert(poLines, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (plErr) throw new Error(`[inventory] purchase_order_lines upsert: ${plErr.message}`)
  log.module('inventory', poLines.length, 'purchase_order_lines')
}

import type { AdminClient } from '../client'
import type { DemoContext } from '../context'
import { detId, faker } from '../rng'
import { log } from '../log'

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  const tattooTemplate = ctx.consentTemplateIds[0]!
  const piercingTemplate = ctx.consentTemplateIds[1]!

  // Fetch completed bookings to link consent submissions
  const { data: bookings } = await sb
    .from('bookings')
    .select('id, client_id, scheduled_at')
    .eq('studio_id', ctx.studioId)
    .eq('status', 'completed')
    .in('id', ctx.completedBookingIds.length > 0 ? ctx.completedBookingIds : ['never'])
    .limit(18)

  // 1. Consent form submissions — 15 signed + some pending request rows
  type Sub = {
    id: string
    studio_id: string
    template_id: string
    template_version: number
    template_snapshot: object
    booking_id: string | null
    client_id: string
    signer_name: string
    signer_email: string | null
    signer_phone: string | null
    answers: object
    signature_path: string
    signature_svg: string | null
    signed_at: string
    ip_address: string | null
    geo_country: string | null
  }
  const submissions: Sub[] = []
  ;(bookings ?? []).slice(0, 15).forEach((b, i) => {
    const name = faker.person.fullName()
    submissions.push({
      id: detId('consent_submission', b.id),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      template_id: i % 5 === 0 ? piercingTemplate : tattooTemplate,
      template_version: 1,
      template_snapshot: { sections: [] },
      booking_id: b.id,
      client_id: b.client_id,
      signer_name: name,
      signer_email: faker.internet.email({ firstName: name.split(' ')[0] }).toLowerCase(),
      signer_phone: `+1 415 555 ${String(2000 + i).slice(-4)}`,
      answers: { allergies: 'None disclosed', medications: 'None' },
      signature_path: `consent/demo/${b.id}.svg`,
      signature_svg: '<svg/>',
      signed_at: new Date(new Date(b.scheduled_at).getTime() - 3600_000).toISOString(),
      ip_address: '10.0.0.1',
      geo_country: 'US',
    })
  })
  for (let i = 0; i < submissions.length; i += 50) {
    const chunk = submissions.slice(i, i + 50)
    const { error } = await sb.from('consent_form_submissions').upsert(chunk, { onConflict: 'id' })
    if (error) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_form_submissions upsert chunk ${i}: ${error.message}`)
  }
  log.module('consent', submissions.length, 'consent_form_submissions')

  // 2. Consent form requests — pending requests not yet signed
  const pendingCandidates = ctx.clientIds.slice(15, 22)
  const requestRows = pendingCandidates.map((clientId, i) => ({
    id: detId('consent_request', `${clientId}:${i}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    template_id: tattooTemplate,
    booking_id: null,
    client_id: clientId,
    sent_to_email: `client-${i}@demo.test`,
    status: i === 0 ? ('opened' as const) : ('pending' as const),
    sent_at: new Date(Date.now() - (3 + i) * 86400_000).toISOString(),
    opened_at: i === 0 ? new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 86400_000).toISOString() : null,
    expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
  }))
  const { error: reqErr } = await sb.from('consent_form_requests').upsert(requestRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (reqErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_form_requests upsert: ${reqErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', requestRows.length, 'consent_form_requests')

  // 3. Consent auto-send rules — 3 defaults
  const autoRules = [
    { trigger: 'any_booking' as const, timing: 'immediately' as const, timing_value: 0 },
    { trigger: 'first_time_client' as const, timing: 'hours_before_session' as const, timing_value: 48 },
    { trigger: 'session_complete' as const, timing: 'minutes_after_complete' as const, timing_value: 30 },
  ]
  const autoRows = autoRules.map((r, i) => ({
    id: detId('consent_auto_rule', `${r.trigger}:${i}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    trigger: r.trigger,
    template_id: tattooTemplate,
    timing: r.timing,
    timing_value: r.timing_value,
    channels: ['email', 'sms'] as const,
    enabled: true,
    is_default: true,
  }))
  const { error: arErr } = await sb.from('consent_auto_send_rules').upsert(autoRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (arErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_auto_send_rules upsert: ${arErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', autoRows.length, 'consent_auto_send_rules')

  // 4. Kiosk session — 1 active
  const { error: kErr } = await sb.from('consent_kiosk_sessions').upsert(
    {
      id: detId('consent_kiosk', 'primary'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      kiosk_token: 'demo-kiosk-token-' + ctx.studioId.slice(0, 8),
      template_id: tattooTemplate,
      enabled: true,
      last_rotated_at: new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
    },
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (kErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_kiosk_sessions upsert: ${kErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', 1, 'consent_kiosk_sessions')

  // 5. Studio ink registry — 8 entries (used by REACH)
  const brands = ['Eternal', 'Dynamic', 'World Famous', 'Intenze', 'Fusion', 'Solid', 'Eclipse', 'Quantum']
  const colors = ['True Black', 'Rich Red', 'Ocean Blue', 'Pure White', 'Bold Yellow', 'Forest Green', 'Hot Pink', 'Deep Purple']
  const inkRegistryRows = brands.slice(0, 8).map((brand, i) => ({
    id: detId('studio_ink_registry', `${brand}:${colors[i]}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    brand,
    color: colors[i]!,
    product_code: `${brand.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}-${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    batch_number: `B${new Date().getFullYear()}${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    manufacture_date: new Date(Date.now() - 180 * 86400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    expiry_date: new Date(Date.now() + (365 - i * 30) * 86400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    reach_compliant: i !== 7,  // last one non-compliant for demo
    sds_url: `https://reach-compliance.demo/sds/${brand.toLowerCase()}-${i}.pdf`,
    supplier_id: ctx.supplierIds[i % ctx.supplierIds.length] ?? null,
    is_active: true,
  }))
  const { error: sirErr } = await sb.from('studio_ink_registry').upsert(inkRegistryRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (sirErr) throw new Error(`[consent] studio_ink_registry upsert: ${sirErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', inkRegistryRows.length, 'studio_ink_registry')

  // 6. REACH ink records — link used inks to completed bookings
  const reachRows = (bookings ?? []).slice(0, 8).map((b, i) => {
    const ink = inkRegistryRows[i % inkRegistryRows.length]!
    return {
      id: detId('reach_ink', `${b.id}:${i}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      submission_id: detId('consent_submission', b.id),
      booking_id: b.id,
      ink_brand: ink.brand,
      ink_color: ink.color,
      ink_product_code: ink.product_code,
      batch_number: ink.batch_number,
      manufacture_date: ink.manufacture_date,
      expiry_date: ink.expiry_date,
      reach_compliant: ink.reach_compliant,
      reach_compliance_source: (ink.reach_compliant ? 'verified' : 'unverified') as 'verified' | 'artist_claimed' | 'unverified',
      sds_url: ink.sds_url,
      used_at: b.scheduled_at,
    }
  })
  const { error: rErr } = await sb.from('reach_ink_records').upsert(reachRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (rErr) throw new Error(`[consent] reach_ink_records upsert: ${rErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', reachRows.length, 'reach_ink_records')
}

    sent_to_email: `client-${i}@demo.test`,
    status: i === 0 ? ('opened' as const) : ('pending' as const),
    sent_at: new Date(Date.now() - (3 + i) * 86400_000).toISOString(),
    opened_at: i === 0 ? new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 86400_000).toISOString() : null,
    expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
  }))
  const { error: reqErr } = await sb.from('consent_form_requests').upsert(requestRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (reqErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_form_requests upsert: ${reqErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', requestRows.length, 'consent_form_requests')

  // 3. Consent auto-send rules — 3 defaults
  const autoRules = [
    { trigger: 'any_booking' as const, timing: 'immediately' as const, timing_value: 0 },
    { trigger: 'first_time_client' as const, timing: 'hours_before_session' as const, timing_value: 48 },
    { trigger: 'session_complete' as const, timing: 'minutes_after_complete' as const, timing_value: 30 },
  ]
  const autoRows = autoRules.map((r, i) => ({
    id: detId('consent_auto_rule', `${r.trigger}:${i}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    trigger: r.trigger,
    template_id: tattooTemplate,
    timing: r.timing,
    timing_value: r.timing_value,
    channels: ['email', 'sms'] as const,
    enabled: true,
    is_default: true,
  }))
  const { error: arErr } = await sb.from('consent_auto_send_rules').upsert(autoRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (arErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_auto_send_rules upsert: ${arErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', autoRows.length, 'consent_auto_send_rules')

  // 4. Kiosk session — 1 active
  const { error: kErr } = await sb.from('consent_kiosk_sessions').upsert(
    {
      id: detId('consent_kiosk', 'primary'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      kiosk_token: 'demo-kiosk-token-' + ctx.studioId.slice(0, 8),
      template_id: tattooTemplate,
      enabled: true,
      last_rotated_at: new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
    },
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (kErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_kiosk_sessions upsert: ${kErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', 1, 'consent_kiosk_sessions')

  // 5. Studio ink registry — 8 entries (used by REACH)
  const brands = ['Eternal', 'Dynamic', 'World Famous', 'Intenze', 'Fusion', 'Solid', 'Eclipse', 'Quantum']
  const colors = ['True Black', 'Rich Red', 'Ocean Blue', 'Pure White', 'Bold Yellow', 'Forest Green', 'Hot Pink', 'Deep Purple']
  const inkRegistryRows = brands.slice(0, 8).map((brand, i) => ({
    id: detId('studio_ink_registry', `${brand}:${colors[i]}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    brand,
    color: colors[i]!,
    product_code: `${brand.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}-${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    batch_number: `B${new Date().getFullYear()}${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    manufacture_date: new Date(Date.now() - 180 * 86400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    expiry_date: new Date(Date.now() + (365 - i * 30) * 86400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    reach_compliant: i !== 7,  // last one non-compliant for demo
    sds_url: `https://reach-compliance.demo/sds/${brand.toLowerCase()}-${i}.pdf`,
    supplier_id: ctx.supplierIds[i % ctx.supplierIds.length] ?? null,
    is_active: true,
  }))
  const { error: sirErr } = await sb.from('studio_ink_registry').upsert(inkRegistryRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (sirErr) throw new Error(`[consent] studio_ink_registry upsert: ${sirErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', inkRegistryRows.length, 'studio_ink_registry')

  // 6. REACH ink records — link used inks to completed bookings
  const reachRows = (bookings ?? []).slice(0, 8).map((b, i) => {
    const ink = inkRegistryRows[i % inkRegistryRows.length]!
    return {
      id: detId('reach_ink', `${b.id}:${i}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      submission_id: detId('consent_submission', b.id),
      booking_id: b.id,
      ink_brand: ink.brand,
      ink_color: ink.color,
      ink_product_code: ink.product_code,
      batch_number: ink.batch_number,
      manufacture_date: ink.manufacture_date,
      expiry_date: ink.expiry_date,
      reach_compliant: ink.reach_compliant,
      reach_compliance_source: (ink.reach_compliant ? 'verified' : 'unverified') as 'verified' | 'artist_claimed' | 'unverified',
      sds_url: ink.sds_url,
      used_at: b.scheduled_at,
    }
  })
  const { error: rErr } = await sb.from('reach_ink_records').upsert(reachRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (rErr) throw new Error(`[consent] reach_ink_records upsert: ${rErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', reachRows.length, 'reach_ink_records')
}

import type { AdminClient } from '../client'
import type { DemoContext } from '../context'
import { detId } from '../rng'
import { log } from '../log'

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  const now = new Date()

  // 1. Marketing campaigns
  const campaigns = [
    {
      id: detId('campaign', 'april-flash'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      name: 'April Flash Day promo',
      type: 'manual' as const,
      channel: 'email' as const,
      status: 'sent' as const,
      template_subject: 'Flash Day — Saturday, one day only',
      template_body: 'Book a walk-in from our flash sheet. 10% off, Saturday only.',
      audience_filter: { tags: ['VIP', 'Recurring'] } as unknown as object,
      scheduled_at: new Date(now.getTime() - 14 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      sent_at: new Date(now.getTime() - 14 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      sent_count: 142,
      open_count: 68,
      click_count: 23,
    },
    {
      id: detId('campaign', 'birthday-offer'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      name: 'Birthday offer — automated',
      type: 'automated' as const,
      channel: 'both' as const,
      status: 'active' as const,
      template_subject: 'Happy birthday — 15% off your next session',
      template_body: 'We saved a little something for you. Book before the month ends.',
      audience_filter: { birthday_within_days: 7 } as unknown as object,
      scheduled_at: null,
      sent_count: 28,
      open_count: 18,
      click_count: 6,
    },
  ]
  const { error: cErr } = await sb.from('marketing_campaigns').upsert(campaigns, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (cErr) throw new Error(`[marketing] marketing_campaigns upsert: ${cErr.message}`)
  log.module('marketing', campaigns.length, 'marketing_campaigns')

  // 2. Referral codes — 3 codes
  const codes = [
    { code: 'FRIEND15', discount: 15, discountType: 'percentage' as const, reward: 2000, rewardType: 'fixed' as const, clientIdx: 0 },
    { code: 'WELCOME20', discount: 2000, discountType: 'fixed' as const, reward: 0, rewardType: 'fixed' as const, clientIdx: null },
    { code: 'SAM10', discount: 10, discountType: 'percentage' as const, reward: 1500, rewardType: 'fixed' as const, clientIdx: 5 },
  ]
  const codeRows = codes.map((c) => ({
    id: detId('referral_code', c.code),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    client_id: c.clientIdx !== null ? ctx.clientIds[c.clientIdx]! : null,
    code: c.code,
    discount_type: c.discountType,
    discount_value: c.discount,
    referrer_reward_type: c.rewardType,
    referrer_reward_value: c.reward,
    max_uses: 50,
    uses_count: 4,
    is_active: true,
    expires_at: new Date(now.getTime() + 90 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
  }))
  const { error: codeErr } = await sb.from('referral_codes').upsert(codeRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (codeErr) throw new Error(`[marketing] referral_codes upsert: ${codeErr.message}`)
  log.module('marketing', codeRows.length, 'referral_codes')

  // 3. Referral redemptions — 3 applied
  const redemptionRows = Array.from({ length: 3 }, (_, i) => ({

import type { AdminClient } from '../client'
import type { DemoContext } from '../context'
import { detId } from '../rng'
import { log } from '../log'

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  const now = new Date()

  // 1. Marketing campaigns
  const campaigns = [
    {
      id: detId('campaign', 'april-flash'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      name: 'April Flash Day promo',
      type: 'manual' as const,
      channel: 'email' as const,
      status: 'sent' as const,
      template_subject: 'Flash Day — Saturday, one day only',
      template_body: 'Book a walk-in from our flash sheet. 10% off, Saturday only.',
      audience_filter: { tags: ['VIP', 'Recurring'] } as unknown as object,
      scheduled_at: new Date(now.getTime() - 14 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      sent_at: new Date(now.getTime() - 14 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      sent_count: 142,
      open_count: 68,
      click_count: 23,
    },
    {
      id: detId('campaign', 'birthday-offer'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      name: 'Birthday offer — automated',
      type: 'automated' as const,
      channel: 'both' as const,
      status: 'active' as const,
      template_subject: 'Happy birthday — 15% off your next session',
      template_body: 'We saved a little something for you. Book before the month ends.',
      audience_filter: { birthday_within_days: 7 } as unknown as object,
      scheduled_at: null,
      sent_count: 28,
      open_count: 18,
      click_count: 6,
    },
  ]
  const { error: cErr } = await sb.from('marketing_campaigns').upsert(campaigns, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (cErr) throw new Error(`[marketing] marketing_campaigns upsert: ${cErr.message}`)
  log.module('marketing', campaigns.length, 'marketing_campaigns')

  // 2. Referral codes — 3 codes
  const codes = [
    { code: 'FRIEND15', discount: 15, discountType: 'percentage' as const, reward: 2000, rewardType: 'fixed' as const, clientIdx: 0 },
    { code: 'WELCOME20', discount: 2000, discountType: 'fixed' as const, reward: 0, rewardType: 'fixed' as const, clientIdx: null },
    { code: 'SAM10', discount: 10, discountType: 'percentage' as const, reward: 1500, rewardType: 'fixed' as const, clientIdx: 5 },
  ]
  const codeRows = codes.map((c) => ({
    id: detId('referral_code', c.code),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    client_id: c.clientIdx !== null ? ctx.clientIds[c.clientIdx]! : null,
    code: c.code,
    discount_type: c.discountType,
    discount_value: c.discount,
    referrer_reward_type: c.rewardType,
    referrer_reward_value: c.reward,
    max_uses: 50,
    uses_count: 4,
    is_active: true,
    expires_at: new Date(now.getTime() + 90 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
  }))
  const { error: codeErr } = await sb.from('referral_codes').upsert(codeRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (codeErr) throw new Error(`[marketing] referral_codes upsert: ${codeErr.message}`)
  log.module('marketing', codeRows.length, 'referral_codes')

  // 3. Referral redemptions — 3 applied
  const redemptionRows = Array.from({ length: 3 }, (_, i) => ({
    id: detId('referral_redemption', `${i}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    code_id: codeRows[i % codeRows.length]!.id,
    referrer_client_id: ctx.clientIds[i]!,
    referred_client_id: ctx.clientIds[i + 10]!,
    booking_id: ctx.bookingIds[i]!,
    discount_amount_cents: 3000,
    referrer_reward_cents: 1500,
    status: 'applied' as const,
  }))
  const { error: redErr } = await sb.from('referral_redemptions').upsert(redemptionRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (redErr) throw new Error(`[marketing] referral_redemptions upsert: ${redErr.message}`)
  log.module('marketing', redemptionRows.length, 'referral_redemptions')
}

import type { AdminClient } from '../client'
import type { DemoContext } from '../context'
import { detId, faker } from '../rng'
import { log } from '../log'
import { DEMO_USERS } from '../constants'

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  const now = Date.now()

  // 1. Audit log — 25 entries across key actions
  const actions = [
    { action: 'studio.updated',           target_type: 'studio' },
    { action: 'artist.created',           target_type: 'artist' },
    { action: 'artist.commission_changed',target_type: 'artist' },
    { action: 'booking.created',          target_type: 'booking' },
    { action: 'booking.cancelled',        target_type: 'booking' },
    { action: 'booking.completed',        target_type: 'booking' },
    { action: 'payment.refunded',         target_type: 'payment' },
    { action: 'payroll.run_approved',     target_type: 'payroll_run' },
    { action: 'payroll.run_paid',         target_type: 'payroll_run' },
    { action: 'client.created',           target_type: 'client' },
    { action: 'client.banned',            target_type: 'client' },
    { action: 'consent.submitted',        target_type: 'consent_form_submission' },
    { action: 'consent.template_updated', target_type: 'consent_form_template' },
    { action: 'inventory.low_stock',      target_type: 'inventory_item' },
    { action: 'inventory.purchase_order_created', target_type: 'purchase_order' },
    { action: 'flash.event_published',    target_type: 'flash_event' },
    { action: 'marketing.campaign_sent',  target_type: 'marketing_campaign' },
    { action: 'settings.feature_flag_toggled', target_type: 'feature_flag' },
    { action: 'ai.design_approved',       target_type: 'ai_design_output' },
    { action: 'settings.member_invited',  target_type: 'team_invite' },
    { action: 'settings.role_changed',    target_type: 'studio_member' },
    { action: 'billing.plan_changed',     target_type: 'subscription' },
    { action: 'reach.ink_registered',     target_type: 'studio_ink_registry' },
    { action: 'settings.ink_registry_exported', target_type: 'studio_ink_registry' },
    { action: 'admin.data_export',        target_type: 'studio' },
  ]
  const actors = [DEMO_USERS.owner.id, DEMO_USERS.artist1.id, DEMO_USERS.recept1.id]
  const auditRows = actions.map((a, i) => ({
    id: detId('audit_log', `${i}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    actor_id: actors[i % actors.length]!,
    action: a.action,
    target_type: a.target_type,
    target_id: detId('audit_target', `${i}`),
    details: { demo: true, seq: i } as unknown as object,
    created_at: new Date(now - (30 - i) * 3600_000 * 2).toISOString(),
  }))
  const { error: aErr } = await sb.from('audit_log').upsert(auditRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (aErr) throw new Error(`[audit] audit_log upsert: ${aErr.message}`)
  log.module('audit', auditRows.length, 'audit_log')

  // 2. Team audit log — 5 entries
  const teamActions: Array<{
    action: 'invited' | 'invite_accepted' | 'role_changed' | 'member_deactivated' | 'member_reactivated'
    target: string
    from: string | null
    to: string | null
  }> = [
    { action: 'invited',             target: DEMO_USERS.artist1.id,  from: null,              to: 'artist'       },
    { action: 'invite_accepted',     target: DEMO_USERS.artist1.id,  from: null,              to: 'artist'       },
    { action: 'role_changed',        target: DEMO_USERS.recept1.id,  from: 'artist',          to: 'receptionist' },
    { action: 'member_deactivated',  target: DEMO_USERS.artist3.id,  from: 'artist',          to: null           },
    { action: 'member_reactivated',  target: DEMO_USERS.artist3.id,  from: null,              to: 'artist'       },
  ]
  const teamRows = teamActions.map((t, i) => ({
    id: detId('team_audit', `${i}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    actor_id: DEMO_USERS.owner.id,
    target_user_id: t.target,
    action: t.action,
    from_role: t.from,
    to_role: t.to,
    details: { demo: true } as unknown as object,
    created_at: new Date(now - (30 - i * 3) * 86400_000).toISOString(),
  }))
  const { error: tErr } = await sb.from('team_audit_log').upsert(teamRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (tErr) throw new Error(`[audit] team_audit_log upsert: ${tErr.message}`)
  log.module('audit', teamRows.length, 'team_audit_log')

  // 3. Webhook events — 10 Dodo events
  const webhookRows = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => ({
    id: detId('webhook_event', `${i}`),
    source: 'dodo_payments',
    event_id: `evt_demo_${String(i).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    payload: {
      type: faker.helpers.arrayElement([
        'payment.succeeded',
        'payment.failed',
        'subscription.created',
        'subscription.updated',
        'invoice.paid',
        'refund.created',
      ]),
      id: `evt_demo_${i}`,
      created_at: new Date(now - i * 3600_000 * 6).toISOString(),
    } as unknown as object,
    processed_at: i === 9 ? null : new Date(now - i * 3600_000 * 6 + 30_000).toISOString(),
    error: i === 9 ? 'Signature verification failed' : null,
    created_at: new Date(now - i * 3600_000 * 6).toISOString(),
  }))
  const { error: wErr } = await sb.from('webhook_events').upsert(webhookRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (wErr) throw new Error(`[audit] webhook_events upsert: ${wErr.message}`)
  log.module('audit', webhookRows.length, 'webhook_events')

  // 4. User pinned items — owner pins 3 nav items
  const pinRows = [
    { id: detId('pin', 'owner:dashboard'),  user_id: DEMO_USERS.owner.id, studio_id: ctx.studioId, kind: 'nav' as const, target: 'dashboard',  label: 'Today',       href: '/dashboard',       icon: 'home',         sort_order: 0 },
    { id: detId('pin', 'owner:calendar'),   user_id: DEMO_USERS.owner.id, studio_id: ctx.studioId, kind: 'nav' as const, target: 'calendar',   label: 'Calendar',    href: '/calendar',        icon: 'calendar',     sort_order: 1 },
    { id: detId('pin', 'owner:payroll'),    user_id: DEMO_USERS.owner.id, studio_id: ctx.studioId, kind: 'nav' as const, target: 'payroll',    label: 'Payroll',     href: '/payroll',         icon: 'dollar-sign',  sort_order: 2 },
  ]
  const { error: pErr } = await sb.from('user_pinned_items').upsert(pinRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (pErr) throw new Error(`[audit] user_pinned_items upsert: ${pErr.message}`)
  log.module('audit', pinRows.length, 'user_pinned_items')
}

import { seed as seedMembers } from './modules/members'

import { seed as seedConsent } from './modules/consent'
import { seed as seedAi } from './modules/ai'
import { seed as seedMarketing } from './modules/marketing'
import { seed as seedFlash } from './modules/flash'

  payments: seedPayments,

  consent: seedConsent,
  ai: seedAi,
  marketing: seedMarketing,
  flash: seedFlash,
  messaging: seedMessaging,
  audit: seedAudit,
} as const

type ModuleName = keyof typeof MODULES

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const args = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2))
  log.header('InkOS demo seed')

}

interface Args {
  only?: ModuleName[]

# InkOS Demo Data Seed

Populates one demo studio with deep, realistic data across every feature area so you can click through the whole app and verify every screen renders with real DB content.

## Commands

```bash
pnpm db:seed:demo           # seed (idempotent — safe to re-run)
pnpm db:seed:demo:reset     # wipe all demo rows + re-seed from scratch
pnpm db:seed:demo:verify    # assert row counts per feature area (exit 1 on fail)
pnpm db:seed:demo --only=bookings,payments   # seed a subset
```

Requires `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` + `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` in `.env.local`. Refuses to run with `NODE_ENV=production`.

## Demo logins

Every user uses password **`Demo123!Aa`**.

| Email                         | Role         | Purpose                                        |
|-------------------------------|--------------|------------------------------------------------|
| `owner@demo.inkos.test`       | owner        | Full-access + platform admin. Test `/admin`.   |
| `artist1@demo.inkos.test`     | artist       | Black-and-grey specialist.                     |
| `artist2@demo.inkos.test`     | artist       | Color, neo-traditional.                        |
| `artist3@demo.inkos.test`     | artist       | Fine-line, walk-ins accepted.                  |
| `guest@demo.inkos.test`       | guest_artist | Active 4-week residency.                       |
| `recept1@demo.inkos.test`     | receptionist | Inbox + consent + front desk.                  |
| `recept2@demo.inkos.test`     | receptionist | Backup receptionist.                           |

## Feature verification matrix

Log in as the listed role and hit the URL. Every page should render non-empty.

| Feature                  | URL                               | Login as   | Expect                                                |
|--------------------------|-----------------------------------|------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| Dashboard KPIs           | `/dashboard`                      | owner      | Revenue + upcoming + low-stock + unsigned consents    |
| Calendar                 | `/calendar`                       | artist1    | 90 days of bookings, mixed states                     |
| Bookings list            | `/bookings`                       | owner      | Confirmed / completed / cancelled / no-show           |
| Clients list             | `/clients`                        | recept1    | 35 clients with tags, notes, preferences              |
| Client detail            | `/clients/[id]`                   | recept1    | Notes + files + consent prefs                         |
| Projects (multi-session) | `/projects`                       | artist1    | 4 projects, ledger entries                            |
| Payments                 | `/payments`                       | owner      | Succeeded + failed + refunded                         |
| Payroll                  | `/payroll`                        | owner      | 3 past runs, summaries, batches                       |
| Commissions              | `/commissions`                    | owner      | Records per artist, 1 disputed, 1 adjusted            |
| Inventory                | `/inventory`                      | recept1    | 23 items + low-stock alerts                           |
| Suppliers / POs          | `/inventory/suppliers`            | owner      | 3 suppliers + 2 POs                                   |
| Consent forms            | `/forms`                          | recept1    | Signed submissions + pending requests                 |

import type { AdminClient } from '../client'
import type { DemoContext } from '../context'
import { detId } from '../rng'
import { log } from '../log'
import { DEMO_LOC_A, DEMO_LOC_B, DEMO_STUDIO_ID, DEMO_STUDIO_NAME, DEMO_STUDIO_SLUG } from '../constants'

const ALL_FEATURES = [
  'booking',
  'calendar',
  'public_booking_page',
  'digital_consent',
  'client_crm',
  'dodo_payments',
  'custom_domain',
  'inventory',
  'commissions',
  'sms_reminders',
  'marketing_basic',
  'marketing_advanced',
  'calendar_sync',
  'referral_program',
  'omnichannel_inbox',
  'messaging_ai_replies',
  'projects',
  'payroll',
  'ai_design',
  'ai_design_assistant',
  'guest_artists',
  'eu_reach',
  'multi_location',
  'analytics',
  'white_label',
  'api_access',
] as const

const STUDIO_PLUS = ALL_FEATURES.slice(0, 17)
const PRO_PLUS = ALL_FEATURES.slice(0, 24)
const SOLO = ALL_FEATURES.slice(0, 7)

const PLANS: Array<{
  id: string
  tier: 'solo' | 'studio' | 'pro' | 'enterprise'
  display_name: string
  price_cents: number
  features: readonly string[]
  sort_order: number
}> = [
  { id: detId('plan', 'solo'),       tier: 'solo',       display_name: 'Solo',       price_cents: 2900,  features: SOLO,          sort_order: 10 },
  { id: detId('plan', 'studio'),     tier: 'studio',     display_name: 'Studio',     price_cents: 5900,  features: STUDIO_PLUS,   sort_order: 20 },
  { id: detId('plan', 'pro'),        tier: 'pro',        display_name: 'Pro',        price_cents: 9900,  features: PRO_PLUS,      sort_order: 30 },
  { id: detId('plan', 'enterprise'), tier: 'enterprise', display_name: 'Enterprise', price_cents: 19900, features: ALL_FEATURES,  sort_order: 40 },
]

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  // 1. Plans (global, not studio-scoped)
  const { error: planErr } = await sb.from('plans').upsert(
    PLANS.map((p) => ({
      id: p.id,
      tier: p.tier,
      billing_cycle: 'monthly' as const,
      dodo_product_id: `demo_${p.tier}_monthly`,
      display_name: p.display_name,
      price_cents: p.price_cents,
      currency: 'USD',
      features: [...p.features] as unknown as object,
      sort_order: p.sort_order,
      is_active: true,
    })),
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (planErr) throw new Error(`[studio] plans upsert: ${planErr.message}`)
  log.module('studio', PLANS.length, 'plans')

  // 2. Studio (enterprise, fully unlocked)
  const enterprisePlanId = PLANS.find((p) => p.tier === 'enterprise')!.id
  const { error: studioErr } = await sb.from('studios').upsert(
    {
      id: DEMO_STUDIO_ID,
      name: DEMO_STUDIO_NAME,
      slug: DEMO_STUDIO_SLUG,
      timezone: 'America/Los_Angeles',
      locale: 'en-US',
      currency: 'USD',
      brand_color: '#B23A2B',
      plan_id: enterprisePlanId,
      status: 'active' as const,
      white_label_enabled: true,
      powered_by_hidden: false,
      deposit_deadline_hours: 48,
      require_intake_before_booking: false,
      intake_timing: 'pre_booking' as const,
      messaging_tone: 'casual' as const,
      messaging_connected_channels: ['email', 'sms'],
    },
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (studioErr) throw new Error(`[studio] studios upsert: ${studioErr.message}`)
  log.module('studio', 1, 'studios')

  // 3. Locations (2: primary + secondary)
  const { error: locErr } = await sb.from('locations').upsert(
    [
      {
        id: DEMO_LOC_A,
        studio_id: DEMO_STUDIO_ID,
        name: 'Downtown Flagship',
        address: '814 Mission St',
        city: 'San Francisco',
        state: 'CA',
        country: 'US',
        zip: '94103',
        phone: '+1 415 555 0101',
        timezone: 'America/Los_Angeles',
        is_primary: true,
        status: 'active' as const,
        opening_hours: {
          mon: { open: '11:00', close: '20:00' },
          tue: { open: '11:00', close: '20:00' },
          wed: { open: '11:00', close: '20:00' },
          thu: { open: '11:00', close: '22:00' },
          fri: { open: '11:00', close: '22:00' },
          sat: { open: '10:00', close: '22:00' },
          sun: { open: '12:00', close: '18:00' },
        },
        description: 'Flagship location with six chairs and a private consult room.',
        social_instagram: 'inkhaus.sf',
        sort_order: 0,
      },
      {
        id: DEMO_LOC_B,

const ALL_FEATURES = [

  'guest_artists',

  'multi_location',
  'analytics',
  'white_label',
  'api_access',
] as const

const STUDIO_PLUS = ALL_FEATURES.slice(0, 17)
const PRO_PLUS = ALL_FEATURES.slice(0, 24)
const SOLO = ALL_FEATURES.slice(0, 7)

const PLANS: Array<{
  id: string
  tier: 'solo' | 'studio' | 'pro' | 'enterprise'
  display_name: string

  { id: detId('plan', 'pro'),        tier: 'pro',        display_name: 'Pro',        price_cents: 9900,  features: PRO_PLUS,      sort_order: 30 },
  { id: detId('plan', 'enterprise'), tier: 'enterprise', display_name: 'Enterprise', price_cents: 19900, features: ALL_FEATURES,  sort_order: 40 },
]

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  // 1. Plans (global, not studio-scoped)
  const { error: planErr } = await sb.from('plans').upsert(
    PLANS.map((p) => ({

  if (planErr) throw new Error(`[studio] plans upsert: ${planErr.message}`)
  log.module('studio', PLANS.length, 'plans')

  // 2. Studio (enterprise, fully unlocked)
  const enterprisePlanId = PLANS.find((p) => p.tier === 'enterprise')!.id
  const { error: studioErr } = await sb.from('studios').upsert(
    {
      id: DEMO_STUDIO_ID,

  log.module('studio', 1, 'studios')

  // 3. Locations (2: primary + secondary)
  const { error: locErr } = await sb.from('locations').upsert(
    [
      {
        id: DEMO_LOC_A,
        studio_id: DEMO_STUDIO_ID,

  )
  if (locErr) throw new Error(`[studio] locations upsert: ${locErr.message}`)
  log.module('studio', 2, 'locations')

  const now = new Date()
  const periodStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1)
  const periodEnd = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 1)
  const trialStart = new Date(now.getTime() - 90 * 86400_000)

      status: 'active' as const,

      trial_end: new Date(trialStart.getTime() + 14 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      current_period_start: periodStart.toISOString(),
      current_period_end: periodEnd.toISOString(),
      cancel_at_period_end: false,
      price_cents: 19900,
      currency: 'USD',
      quantity: 1,
      metadata: asJson({ demo: true }),

    { onConflict: 'id' },

  if (subErr) throw new Error(`[studio] subscriptions upsert: ${subErr.message}`)
  log.module('studio', 1, 'subscriptions')

  // 5. Domain verification
  const { error: domErr } = await sb.from('domain_verifications').upsert(

  )
  if (domErr) throw new Error(`[studio] domain_verifications upsert: ${domErr.message}`)
  log.module('studio', 1, 'domain_verifications')

  // 6. Usage meters (current period)
  const meters: Array<{
    meter: 'sms_sent' | 'ai_generations' | 'bookings_created' | 'active_artists' | 'active_locations' | 'storage_mb'
    used: number
    quota: number

    { meter: 'active_locations', used: 2,   quota: 10 },

import type { AdminClient } from '../client'
import type { DemoContext } from '../context'
import { detId, faker } from '../rng'
import { log } from '../log'
import { DEMO_USERS } from '../constants'

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  const now = Date.now()

  // 1. Audit log — 25 entries across key actions
  const actions = [
    { action: 'studio.updated',           target_type: 'studio' },
    { action: 'artist.created',           target_type: 'artist' },
    { action: 'artist.commission_changed',target_type: 'artist' },
    { action: 'booking.created',          target_type: 'booking' },
    { action: 'booking.cancelled',        target_type: 'booking' },
    { action: 'booking.completed',        target_type: 'booking' },
    { action: 'payment.refunded',         target_type: 'payment' },
    { action: 'payroll.run_approved',     target_type: 'payroll_run' },
    { action: 'payroll.run_paid',         target_type: 'payroll_run' },
    { action: 'client.created',           target_type: 'client' },
    { action: 'client.banned',            target_type: 'client' },
    { action: 'consent.submitted',        target_type: 'consent_form_submission' },
    { action: 'consent.template_updated', target_type: 'consent_form_template' },
    { action: 'inventory.low_stock',      target_type: 'inventory_item' },
    { action: 'inventory.purchase_order_created', target_type: 'purchase_order' },
    { action: 'flash.event_published',    target_type: 'flash_event' },
    { action: 'marketing.campaign_sent',  target_type: 'marketing_campaign' },
    { action: 'settings.feature_flag_toggled', target_type: 'feature_flag' },
    { action: 'ai.design_approved',       target_type: 'ai_design_output' },
    { action: 'settings.member_invited',  target_type: 'team_invite' },
    { action: 'settings.role_changed',    target_type: 'studio_member' },
    { action: 'billing.plan_changed',     target_type: 'subscription' },
    { action: 'reach.ink_registered',     target_type: 'studio_ink_registry' },
    { action: 'settings.ink_registry_exported', target_type: 'studio_ink_registry' },
    { action: 'admin.data_export',        target_type: 'studio' },
  ]
  const actors = [DEMO_USERS.owner.id, DEMO_USERS.artist1.id, DEMO_USERS.recept1.id]
  const auditRows = actions.map((a, i) => ({
    id: detId('audit_log', `${i}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    actor_id: actors[i % actors.length]!,
    action: a.action,
    target_type: a.target_type,
    target_id: detId('audit_target', `${i}`),
    details: { demo: true, seq: i } as unknown as object,
    created_at: new Date(now - (30 - i) * 3600_000 * 2).toISOString(),
  }))
  const { error: aErr } = await sb.from('audit_log').upsert(auditRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (aErr) throw new Error(`[audit] audit_log upsert: ${aErr.message}`)
  log.module('audit', auditRows.length, 'audit_log')

  // 2. Team audit log — 5 entries
  const teamActions: Array<{
    action: 'invited' | 'invite_accepted' | 'role_changed' | 'member_deactivated' | 'member_reactivated'
    target: string
    from: string | null
    to: string | null
  }> = [
    { action: 'invited',             target: DEMO_USERS.artist1.id,  from: null,              to: 'artist'       },
    { action: 'invite_accepted',     target: DEMO_USERS.artist1.id,  from: null,              to: 'artist'       },
    { action: 'role_changed',        target: DEMO_USERS.recept1.id,  from: 'artist',          to: 'receptionist' },
    { action: 'member_deactivated',  target: DEMO_USERS.artist3.id,  from: 'artist',          to: null           },
    { action: 'member_reactivated',  target: DEMO_USERS.artist3.id,  from: null,              to: 'artist'       },
  ]
  const teamRows = teamActions.map((t, i) => ({
    id: detId('team_audit', `${i}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    actor_id: DEMO_USERS.owner.id,
    target_user_id: t.target,
    action: t.action,
    from_role: t.from,
    to_role: t.to,
    details: { demo: true } as unknown as object,
    created_at: new Date(now - (30 - i * 3) * 86400_000).toISOString(),
  }))
  const { error: tErr } = await sb.from('team_audit_log').upsert(teamRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (tErr) throw new Error(`[audit] team_audit_log upsert: ${tErr.message}`)
  log.module('audit', teamRows.length, 'team_audit_log')

  // 3. Webhook events — 10 Dodo events
  const webhookRows = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => ({
    id: detId('webhook_event', `${i}`),
    source: 'dodo_payments',
    event_id: `evt_demo_${String(i).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    payload: {
      type: faker.helpers.arrayElement([
        'payment.succeeded',
        'payment.failed',
        'subscription.created',
        'subscription.updated',
        'invoice.paid',
        'refund.created',
      ]),
      id: `evt_demo_${i}`,
      created_at: new Date(now - i * 3600_000 * 6).toISOString(),
    } as unknown as object,
    processed_at: i === 9 ? null : new Date(now - i * 3600_000 * 6 + 30_000).toISOString(),
    error: i === 9 ? 'Signature verification failed' : null,
    created_at: new Date(now - i * 3600_000 * 6).toISOString(),
  }))
  const { error: wErr } = await sb.from('webhook_events').upsert(webhookRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (wErr) throw new Error(`[audit] webhook_events upsert: ${wErr.message}`)
  log.module('audit', webhookRows.length, 'webhook_events')

  // 4. User pinned items — owner pins 3 nav items
  const pinRows = [
    { id: detId('pin', 'owner:dashboard'),  user_id: DEMO_USERS.owner.id, studio_id: ctx.studioId, kind: 'nav' as const, target: 'dashboard',  label: 'Today',       href: '/dashboard',       icon: 'home',         sort_order: 0 },
    { id: detId('pin', 'owner:calendar'),   user_id: DEMO_USERS.owner.id, studio_id: ctx.studioId, kind: 'nav' as const, target: 'calendar',   label: 'Calendar',    href: '/calendar',        icon: 'calendar',     sort_order: 1 },
    { id: detId('pin', 'owner:payroll'),    user_id: DEMO_USERS.owner.id, studio_id: ctx.studioId, kind: 'nav' as const, target: 'payroll',    label: 'Payroll',     href: '/payroll',         icon: 'dollar-sign',  sort_order: 2 },
  ]
  const { error: pErr } = await sb.from('user_pinned_items').upsert(pinRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (pErr) throw new Error(`[audit] user_pinned_items upsert: ${pErr.message}`)
  log.module('audit', pinRows.length, 'user_pinned_items')
}

import type { AdminClient } from '../client'
import type { DemoContext } from '../context'
import { detId, faker, weighted } from '../rng'
import { log } from '../log'
import { DEMO_USERS } from '../constants'

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  // Fetch booking details needed for payment creation
  const { data: bookings, error: bErr } = await sb
    .from('bookings')
    .select('id, client_id, status, price_cents, deposit_cents, deposit_paid, balance_paid, tip_cents, scheduled_at, deposit_paid_at, balance_paid_at')
    .eq('studio_id', ctx.studioId)
    .in('id', ctx.bookingIds)
  if (bErr) throw new Error(`[payments] booking fetch: ${bErr.message}`)
  if (!bookings) throw new Error('[payments] no bookings found')

  type PaymentType = 'subscription' | 'deposit' | 'balance' | 'tip' | 'refund' | 'adjustment'
  type PaymentStatus = 'pending' | 'processing' | 'succeeded' | 'failed' | 'refunded' | 'partially_refunded'

  type Row = {
    id: string
    studio_id: string
    booking_id: string | null
    client_id: string | null
    dodo_payment_id: string
    type: PaymentType
    amount_cents: number
    currency: string
    status: PaymentStatus
    succeeded_at: string | null
    description: string
    refund_amount_cents: number
    refunded_at: string | null
    refund_reason: string | null
    metadata: Record<string, unknown>
  }

  const payments: Row[] = []
  let idx = 0

  // Deposit payments — one per booking with deposit_paid
  for (const b of bookings) {
    if (b.deposit_paid && b.deposit_cents > 0) {
      payments.push({
        id: detId('payment', `deposit:${b.id}`),
        studio_id: ctx.studioId,
        booking_id: b.id,
        client_id: b.client_id,
        dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_dep_${String(idx).padStart(5, '0')}`,
        type: 'deposit',
        amount_cents: b.deposit_cents,
        currency: 'USD',
        status: 'succeeded',
        succeeded_at: b.deposit_paid_at,
        description: `Deposit for booking`,
        refund_amount_cents: 0,
        refunded_at: null,
        refund_reason: null,
        metadata: { demo: true },
      })
      idx++
    }
    // Balance payments — when completed
    if (b.balance_paid && b.price_cents > 0) {
      payments.push({
        id: detId('payment', `balance:${b.id}`),
        studio_id: ctx.studioId,
        booking_id: b.id,
        client_id: b.client_id,
        dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_bal_${String(idx).padStart(5, '0')}`,
        type: 'balance',
        amount_cents: Math.max(0, b.price_cents - b.deposit_cents),
        currency: 'USD',
        status: 'succeeded',
        succeeded_at: b.balance_paid_at,
        description: `Balance for booking`,
        refund_amount_cents: 0,
        refunded_at: null,
        refund_reason: null,
        metadata: { demo: true },
      })
      idx++
    }
    // Tip
    if (b.balance_paid && b.tip_cents && b.tip_cents > 0) {
      payments.push({
        id: detId('payment', `tip:${b.id}`),
        studio_id: ctx.studioId,
        booking_id: b.id,
        client_id: b.client_id,
        dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_tip_${String(idx).padStart(5, '0')}`,
        type: 'tip',
        amount_cents: b.tip_cents,
        currency: 'USD',
        status: 'succeeded',
        succeeded_at: b.balance_paid_at,
        description: `Tip`,
        refund_amount_cents: 0,
        refunded_at: null,
        refund_reason: null,
        metadata: { demo: true },
      })
      idx++
    }
  }

  // 3 failed payments (deposit attempts that failed)
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const b = bookings[bookings.length - 1 - i]!
    payments.push({
      id: detId('payment', `failed:${b.id}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      booking_id: b.id,
      client_id: b.client_id,
      dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_failed_${i}`,
      type: 'deposit',
      amount_cents: b.deposit_cents || 10000,
      currency: 'USD',
      status: 'failed',
      succeeded_at: null,
      description: `Failed deposit attempt`,
      refund_amount_cents: 0,
      refunded_at: null,
      refund_reason: null,
      metadata: { demo: true, failure_code: 'card_declined' },
    })
  }

  // 2 refunded payments (full refund on cancelled bookings)
  const cancelled = bookings.filter((b) => b.status === 'cancelled' && b.deposit_cents > 0).slice(0, 2)
  for (const b of cancelled) {
    payments.push({
      id: detId('payment', `refunded:${b.id}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      booking_id: b.id,
      client_id: b.client_id,
      dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_refunded_${b.id.slice(0, 8)}`,
      type: 'deposit',
      amount_cents: b.deposit_cents,
      currency: 'USD',
      status: 'refunded',
      succeeded_at: new Date(Date.now() - 14 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      description: `Refunded deposit — cancelled booking`,
      refund_amount_cents: b.deposit_cents,
      refunded_at: new Date(Date.now() - 12 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      refund_reason: 'client_requested',
      metadata: { demo: true },
    })
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < payments.length; i += 100) {
    const chunk = payments.slice(i, i + 100)
    const { error } = await sb.from('payments').upsert(chunk, { onConflict: 'id' })
    if (error) throw new Error(`[payments] payments upsert chunk ${i}: ${error.message}`)
  }
  log.module('payments', payments.length, 'payments')
  ctx.paymentIds = payments.map((p) => p.id)

  // Refund requests (2 pending + 1 approved)
  const refundCandidates = bookings.filter((b) => b.status === 'completed').slice(0, 3)
  const refundRows = refundCandidates.map((b, i) => ({
    id: detId('refund_request', b.id),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    booking_id: b.id,
    payment_id: detId('payment', `balance:${b.id}`),
    requested_by: DEMO_USERS.recept1.id,
    amount_cents: Math.floor((b.price_cents || 20000) * 0.5),
    reason: faker.helpers.arrayElement([
      'Client dissatisfied with partial result',
      'Stencil mis-sized',
      'Shop error — scheduling overlap',
    ]),
    status: i === 0 ? ('approved' as const) : i === 1 ? ('pending' as const) : ('processed' as const),
    processed_at: i === 2 ? new Date(Date.now() - 3 * 86400_000).toISOString() : null,
    approver_notes: i === 0 ? 'Approved by owner' : null,
  }))
  const { error: refErr } = await sb.from('refund_requests').upsert(refundRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (refErr) throw new Error(`[payments] refund_requests upsert: ${refErr.message}`)
  log.module('payments', refundRows.length, 'refund_requests')

  // Invoices — 3 past subscription invoices for the studio itself
  const now = new Date()
  const invoiceRows = Array.from({ length: 3 }, (_, i) => {
    const periodStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - (i + 1), 1)
    const periodEnd = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - i, 1)
    return {
      id: detId('invoice', `sub:${i}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      subscription_id: detId('subscription', 'primary'),
      dodo_invoice_id: `inv_demo_${periodStart.toISOString().slice(0, 7)}`,
      dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_sub_${periodStart.toISOString().slice(0, 7)}`,
      amount_cents: 19900,
      tax_cents: 0,
      currency: 'USD',
      status: 'paid' as const,
      period_start: periodStart.toISOString(),
      period_end: periodEnd.toISOString(),
      paid_at: periodStart.toISOString(),
      line_items: [{ label: 'Enterprise plan — monthly', amount_cents: 19900 }] as unknown as object,
      metadata: { demo: true } as unknown as object,
    }
  })
  const { error: invErr } = await sb.from('invoices').upsert(invoiceRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (invErr) throw new Error(`[payments] invoices upsert: ${invErr.message}`)
  log.module('payments', invoiceRows.length, 'invoices')

  // Project deposit transactions — ledger entries for projects
  type PDTRow = {
    id: string
    project_id: string
    type: 'received' | 'applied' | 'refunded' | 'consumed'
    amount_cents: number
    method: string | null
    external_id: string | null
    note: string | null
    created_by: string
  }
  const pdtRows: PDTRow[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < ctx.projectIds.length; i++) {
    const projectId = ctx.projectIds[i]!
    pdtRows.push({
      id: detId('pdt', `${projectId}:received`),
      project_id: projectId,
      type: 'received',
      amount_cents: 30000,
      method: 'stripe',
      external_id: `pi_demo_project_${i}`,
      note: 'Initial deposit received',
      created_by: DEMO_USERS.recept1.id,
    })
    pdtRows.push({
      id: detId('pdt', `${projectId}:applied`),
      project_id: projectId,
      type: 'applied',
      amount_cents: 10000,
      method: null,
      external_id: null,
      note: 'Applied to session 1',
      created_by: DEMO_USERS.owner.id,
    })
  }
  const { error: pdtErr } = await sb.from('project_deposit_transactions').upsert(pdtRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (pdtErr) throw new Error(`[payments] project_deposit_transactions upsert: ${pdtErr.message}`)
  log.module('payments', pdtRows.length, 'project_deposit_transactions')

  // Silence unused-var lint from weighted import
  void weighted
}

        dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_bal_${String(idx).padStart(5, '0')}`,
        type: 'balance',
        amount_cents: Math.max(0, b.price_cents - b.deposit_cents),
        currency: 'USD',
        status: 'succeeded',
        succeeded_at: b.balance_paid_at,
        description: `Balance for booking`,
        refund_amount_cents: 0,
        refunded_at: null,
        refund_reason: null,
        metadata: { demo: true },
      })
      idx++
    }
    // Tip
    if (b.balance_paid && b.tip_cents && b.tip_cents > 0) {
      payments.push({
        id: detId('payment', `tip:${b.id}`),
        studio_id: ctx.studioId,
        booking_id: b.id,
        client_id: b.client_id,
        dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_tip_${String(idx).padStart(5, '0')}`,
        type: 'tip',
        amount_cents: b.tip_cents,
        currency: 'USD',
        status: 'succeeded',
        succeeded_at: b.balance_paid_at,
        description: `Tip`,
        refund_amount_cents: 0,
        refunded_at: null,
        refund_reason: null,
        metadata: { demo: true },
      })
      idx++
    }
  }

  // 3 failed payments (deposit attempts that failed)
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const b = bookings[bookings.length - 1 - i]!
    payments.push({
      id: detId('payment', `failed:${b.id}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      booking_id: b.id,
      client_id: b.client_id,
      dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_failed_${i}`,
      type: 'deposit',
      amount_cents: b.deposit_cents || 10000,
      currency: 'USD',
      status: 'failed',
      succeeded_at: null,
      description: `Failed deposit attempt`,
      refund_amount_cents: 0,
      refunded_at: null,
      refund_reason: null,
      metadata: { demo: true, failure_code: 'card_declined' },
    })
  }

  // 2 refunded payments (full refund on cancelled bookings)
  const cancelled = bookings.filter((b) => b.status === 'cancelled' && b.deposit_cents > 0).slice(0, 2)
  for (const b of cancelled) {
    payments.push({
      id: detId('payment', `refunded:${b.id}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      booking_id: b.id,
      client_id: b.client_id,
      dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_refunded_${b.id.slice(0, 8)}`,
      type: 'deposit',
      amount_cents: b.deposit_cents,
      currency: 'USD',
      status: 'refunded',
      succeeded_at: new Date(Date.now() - 14 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      description: `Refunded deposit — cancelled booking`,
      refund_amount_cents: b.deposit_cents,
      refunded_at: new Date(Date.now() - 12 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      refund_reason: 'client_requested',
      metadata: { demo: true },
    })
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < payments.length; i += 100) {
    const chunk = payments.slice(i, i + 100)
    const { error } = await sb.from('payments').upsert(chunk, { onConflict: 'id' })
    if (error) throw new Error(`[payments] payments upsert chunk ${i}: ${error.message}`)
  }
  log.module('payments', payments.length, 'payments')
  ctx.paymentIds = payments.map((p) => p.id)

  // Refund requests (2 pending + 1 approved)
  const refundCandidates = bookings.filter((b) => b.status === 'completed').slice(0, 3)
  const refundRows = refundCandidates.map((b, i) => ({
    id: detId('refund_request', b.id),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    booking_id: b.id,
    payment_id: detId('payment', `balance:${b.id}`),
    requested_by: DEMO_USERS.recept1.id,
    amount_cents: Math.floor((b.price_cents || 20000) * 0.5),
    reason: faker.helpers.arrayElement([
      'Client dissatisfied with partial result',
      'Stencil mis-sized',
      'Shop error — scheduling overlap',
    ]),
    status: i === 0 ? ('approved' as const) : i === 1 ? ('pending' as const) : ('processed' as const),
    processed_at: i === 2 ? new Date(Date.now() - 3 * 86400_000).toISOString() : null,
    approver_notes: i === 0 ? 'Approved by owner' : null,
  }))
  const { error: refErr } = await sb.from('refund_requests').upsert(refundRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (refErr) throw new Error(`[payments] refund_requests upsert: ${refErr.message}`)
  log.module('payments', refundRows.length, 'refund_requests')

  // Invoices — 3 past subscription invoices for the studio itself
  const now = new Date()
  const invoiceRows = Array.from({ length: 3 }, (_, i) => {
    const periodStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - (i + 1), 1)
    const periodEnd = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - i, 1)
    return {
      id: detId('invoice', `sub:${i}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      subscription_id: detId('subscription', 'primary'),
      dodo_invoice_id: `inv_demo_${periodStart.toISOString().slice(0, 7)}`,
      dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_sub_${periodStart.toISOString().slice(0, 7)}`,
      amount_cents: 19900,
      tax_cents: 0,
      currency: 'USD',
      status: 'paid' as const,
      period_start: periodStart.toISOString(),
      period_end: periodEnd.toISOString(),
      paid_at: periodStart.toISOString(),
      line_items: asJson([{ label: 'Enterprise plan — monthly', amount_cents: 19900 }]),
      metadata: asJson({ demo: true }),
    }
  })
  const { error: invErr } = await sb.from('invoices').upsert(invoiceRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (invErr) throw new Error(`[payments] invoices upsert: ${invErr.message}`)
  log.module('payments', invoiceRows.length, 'invoices')

  // Project deposit transactions — ledger entries for projects
  type PDTRow = {
    id: string
    project_id: string
    type: 'received' | 'applied' | 'refunded' | 'consumed'
    amount_cents: number
    method: string | null
    external_id: string | null
    note: string | null
    created_by: string
  }
  const pdtRows: PDTRow[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < ctx.projectIds.length; i++) {
    const projectId = ctx.projectIds[i]!
    pdtRows.push({
      id: detId('pdt', `${projectId}:received`),
      project_id: projectId,
      type: 'received',
      amount_cents: 30000,
      method: 'stripe',
      external_id: `pi_demo_project_${i}`,
      note: 'Initial deposit received',
      created_by: DEMO_USERS.recept1.id,
    })
    pdtRows.push({
      id: detId('pdt', `${projectId}:applied`),
      project_id: projectId,
      type: 'applied',
      amount_cents: 10000,
      method: null,
      external_id: null,
      note: 'Applied to session 1',
      created_by: DEMO_USERS.owner.id,
    })
  }
  const { error: pdtErr } = await sb.from('project_deposit_transactions').upsert(pdtRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (pdtErr) throw new Error(`[payments] project_deposit_transactions upsert: ${pdtErr.message}`)
  log.module('payments', pdtRows.length, 'project_deposit_transactions')

import type { AdminClient } from '../client'
import type { DemoContext } from '../context'
import { detId, faker } from '../rng'
import { log } from '../log'

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  const tattooTemplate = ctx.consentTemplateIds[0]!
  const piercingTemplate = ctx.consentTemplateIds[1]!

  // Fetch completed bookings to link consent submissions
  const { data: bookings } = await sb
    .from('bookings')
    .select('id, client_id, scheduled_at')
    .eq('studio_id', ctx.studioId)
    .eq('status', 'completed')
    .in('id', ctx.completedBookingIds.length > 0 ? ctx.completedBookingIds : ['never'])
    .limit(18)

  // 1. Consent form submissions — 15 signed + some pending request rows
  type Sub = {
    id: string
    studio_id: string
    template_id: string
    template_version: number
    template_snapshot: object
    booking_id: string | null
    client_id: string
    signer_name: string
    signer_email: string | null
    signer_phone: string | null
    answers: object
    signature_path: string
    signature_svg: string | null
    signed_at: string
    ip_address: string | null
    geo_country: string | null
  }
  const submissions: Sub[] = []
  ;(bookings ?? []).slice(0, 15).forEach((b, i) => {
    const name = faker.person.fullName()
    submissions.push({
      id: detId('consent_submission', b.id),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      template_id: i % 5 === 0 ? piercingTemplate : tattooTemplate,
      template_version: 1,
      template_snapshot: { sections: [] },
      booking_id: b.id,
      client_id: b.client_id,
      signer_name: name,
      signer_email: faker.internet.email({ firstName: name.split(' ')[0] }).toLowerCase(),
      signer_phone: `+1 415 555 ${String(2000 + i).slice(-4)}`,
      answers: { allergies: 'None disclosed', medications: 'None' },
      signature_path: `consent/demo/${b.id}.svg`,
      signature_svg: '<svg/>',
      signed_at: new Date(new Date(b.scheduled_at).getTime() - 3600_000).toISOString(),
      ip_address: '10.0.0.1',
      geo_country: 'US',
    })
  })
  for (let i = 0; i < submissions.length; i += 50) {
    const chunk = submissions.slice(i, i + 50)
    const { error } = await sb.from('consent_form_submissions').upsert(chunk, { onConflict: 'id' })
    if (error) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_form_submissions upsert chunk ${i}: ${error.message}`)
  }
  log.module('consent', submissions.length, 'consent_form_submissions')

  // 2. Consent form requests — pending requests not yet signed
  const pendingCandidates = ctx.clientIds.slice(15, 22)
  const requestRows = pendingCandidates.map((clientId, i) => ({
    id: detId('consent_request', `${clientId}:${i}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    template_id: tattooTemplate,
    booking_id: null,
    client_id: clientId,
    sent_to_email: `client-${i}@demo.test`,
    status: i === 0 ? ('opened' as const) : ('pending' as const),
    sent_at: new Date(Date.now() - (3 + i) * 86400_000).toISOString(),
    opened_at: i === 0 ? new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 86400_000).toISOString() : null,
    expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
  }))
  const { error: reqErr } = await sb.from('consent_form_requests').upsert(requestRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (reqErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_form_requests upsert: ${reqErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', requestRows.length, 'consent_form_requests')

  // 3. Consent auto-send rules — 3 defaults
  const autoRules = [
    { trigger: 'any_booking' as const, timing: 'immediately' as const, timing_value: 0 },
    { trigger: 'first_time_client' as const, timing: 'hours_before_session' as const, timing_value: 48 },
    { trigger: 'session_complete' as const, timing: 'minutes_after_complete' as const, timing_value: 30 },
  ]
  const autoRows = autoRules.map((r, i) => ({
    id: detId('consent_auto_rule', `${r.trigger}:${i}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    trigger: r.trigger,
    template_id: tattooTemplate,
    timing: r.timing,
    timing_value: r.timing_value,
    channels: ['email', 'sms'] as const,
    enabled: true,
    is_default: true,
  }))
  const { error: arErr } = await sb.from('consent_auto_send_rules').upsert(autoRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (arErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_auto_send_rules upsert: ${arErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', autoRows.length, 'consent_auto_send_rules')

  // 4. Kiosk session — 1 active
  const { error: kErr } = await sb.from('consent_kiosk_sessions').upsert(
    {
      id: detId('consent_kiosk', 'primary'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      kiosk_token: 'demo-kiosk-token-' + ctx.studioId.slice(0, 8),
      template_id: tattooTemplate,
      enabled: true,
      last_rotated_at: new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
    },
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (kErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_kiosk_sessions upsert: ${kErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', 1, 'consent_kiosk_sessions')

  // 5. Studio ink registry — 8 entries (used by REACH)
  const brands = ['Eternal', 'Dynamic', 'World Famous', 'Intenze', 'Fusion', 'Solid', 'Eclipse', 'Quantum']
  const colors = ['True Black', 'Rich Red', 'Ocean Blue', 'Pure White', 'Bold Yellow', 'Forest Green', 'Hot Pink', 'Deep Purple']
  const inkRegistryRows = brands.slice(0, 8).map((brand, i) => ({
    id: detId('studio_ink_registry', `${brand}:${colors[i]}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    brand,
    color: colors[i]!,
    product_code: `${brand.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}-${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    batch_number: `B${new Date().getFullYear()}${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    manufacture_date: new Date(Date.now() - 180 * 86400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    expiry_date: new Date(Date.now() + (365 - i * 30) * 86400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    reach_compliant: i !== 7,  // last one non-compliant for demo
    sds_url: `https://reach-compliance.demo/sds/${brand.toLowerCase()}-${i}.pdf`,
    supplier_id: ctx.supplierIds[i % ctx.supplierIds.length] ?? null,
    is_active: true,
  }))
  const { error: sirErr } = await sb.from('studio_ink_registry').upsert(inkRegistryRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (sirErr) throw new Error(`[consent] studio_ink_registry upsert: ${sirErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', inkRegistryRows.length, 'studio_ink_registry')

  // 6. REACH ink records — link used inks to completed bookings
  const reachRows = (bookings ?? []).slice(0, 8).map((b, i) => {
    const ink = inkRegistryRows[i % inkRegistryRows.length]!
    return {
      id: detId('reach_ink', `${b.id}:${i}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      submission_id: detId('consent_submission', b.id),
      booking_id: b.id,
      ink_brand: ink.brand,
      ink_color: ink.color,
      ink_product_code: ink.product_code,
      batch_number: ink.batch_number,
      manufacture_date: ink.manufacture_date,
      expiry_date: ink.expiry_date,
      reach_compliant: ink.reach_compliant,
      reach_compliance_source: (ink.reach_compliant ? 'verified' : 'unverified') as 'verified' | 'artist_claimed' | 'unverified',
      sds_url: ink.sds_url,
      used_at: b.scheduled_at,
    }
  })
  const { error: rErr } = await sb.from('reach_ink_records').upsert(reachRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (rErr) throw new Error(`[consent] reach_ink_records upsert: ${rErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', reachRows.length, 'reach_ink_records')
}
