const FUTURE_DAYS = 30
const BOOKINGS_PER_DAY_AVG = 1.1  // ~99 bookings total across 90 days

type BookingStatus = 'pending' | 'confirmed' | 'in_progress' | 'completed' | 'cancelled' | 'no_show'

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  const today = new Date()
  today.setHours(12, 0, 0, 0)

  // 1. Projects — 4 multi-session projects (for 4 clients)
  const projectRows = Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => {
    const client = ctx.clientIds[i]!
    const artist = ctx.artistIds[i % ctx.artistIds.length]!
    return {
      id: detId('project', `${i}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      client_id: client,
      primary_artist_id: artist,
      name: faker.helpers.arrayElement([
        'Dragon Half-Sleeve',
        'Botanical Back Piece',
        'Abstract Chest Panel',
        'Geometric Forearm Wrap',
      ]),
      description: faker.lorem.sentence({ min: 12, max: 20 }),
      placement: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['left_forearm', 'upper_back', 'chest', 'right_sleeve']),
      style: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['black_and_grey', 'color', 'neo_traditional']),
      status: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['planning', 'active', 'active', 'healing'] as const),
      total_sessions_planned: faker.number.int({ min: 3, max: 6 }),
      total_price_cents: faker.number.int({ min: 150000, max: 400000 }),
      deposit_pool_cents: 30000,
      deposit_applied_cents: 0,
      size: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['small', 'medium', 'large', 'xl']),
      color_mode: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['black_and_grey', 'color']),
      deposit_apply_rule: 'first_session',
      secondary_artist_ids: [] as string[],
      style_tags: [] as string[],
      sessions_completed: 1,
      started_at: new Date(today.getTime() - 45 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
    }
  })
  const { error: pErr } = await sb.from('projects').upsert(projectRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (pErr) throw new Error(`[bookings] projects upsert: ${pErr.message}`)
  log.module('bookings', projectRows.length, 'projects')
  ctx.projectIds = projectRows.map((r) => r.id)

  // 2. Bookings — past 60d + future 30d, mixed statuses
  type BookingRow = {
    id: string
    studio_id: string
    client_id: string
    artist_id: string
    service_id: string
    location_id: string
    scheduled_at: string
    duration_min: number
    status: BookingStatus
    price_cents: number
    deposit_cents: number
    deposit_paid: boolean
    deposit_paid_at: string | null
    balance_paid: boolean
    balance_paid_at: string | null
    tip_cents: number
    source: 'internal' | 'public' | 'waitlist' | 'import'
    notes: string | null
    project_id: string | null
    session_number: number | null
    cancelled_at: string | null
    cancellation_reason: string | null
    cancelled_by: string | null
    consent_required: boolean
    consent_signed_at: string | null
  }

  const bookings: BookingRow[] = []
  let bookingIdx = 0
  for (let dayOffset = -PAST_DAYS; dayOffset <= FUTURE_DAYS; dayOffset++) {
    const count = faker.number.int({ min: 0, max: 3 })
    for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
      const day = new Date(today)
      day.setDate(today.getDate() + dayOffset)
      day.setHours(faker.number.int({ min: 11, max: 18 }), faker.helpers.arrayElement([0, 30]), 0, 0)

      const isPast = dayOffset < 0
      const isToday = dayOffset === 0
      const status: BookingStatus = isPast
        ? weighted<BookingStatus>([
            ['completed', 75],
            ['cancelled', 10],
            ['no_show', 8],
            ['confirmed', 7], // past confirmed but never marked complete
          ])
        : isToday
        ? weighted<BookingStatus>([
            ['in_progress', 20],
            ['confirmed', 55],
            ['completed', 20],
            ['pending', 5],
          ])
        : weighted<BookingStatus>([
            ['confirmed', 75],
            ['pending', 20],
            ['cancelled', 5],
          ])

      const serviceId = ctx.serviceIds[bookingIdx % ctx.serviceIds.length]!
      const artistId = ctx.artistIds[bookingIdx % ctx.artistIds.length]!
      const clientId = ctx.clientIds[bookingIdx % ctx.clientIds.length]!
      const locationId = bookingIdx % 3 === 0 ? ctx.locations.secondary : ctx.locations.primary

      const serviceHints: Array<{ price: number; deposit: number; duration: number }> = [
        { price: 22000, deposit: 10000, duration: 120 },
        { price: 65000, deposit: 20000, duration: 240 },
        { price: 95000, deposit: 30000, duration: 360 },
        { price: 18000, deposit: 8000, duration: 90 },
        { price: 0, deposit: 0, duration: 45 },
        { price: 0, deposit: 0, duration: 30 },
        { price: 7500, deposit: 2500, duration: 30 },
        { price: 12000, deposit: 5000, duration: 45 },
      ]
      const svcHint = serviceHints[bookingIdx % ctx.serviceIds.length]!

      const depositPaid = status !== 'pending' && status !== 'cancelled' && svcHint.deposit > 0
      const balancePaid = status === 'completed'

      // Project linkage — every 8th booking ties to a project
      const projectIdx = bookingIdx % 8 === 0 ? bookingIdx / 8 : null
      const projectId = projectIdx !== null && projectIdx < projectRows.length ? projectRows[projectIdx]!.id : null
      const sessionNumber = projectId ? ((bookingIdx % 4) + 1) : null

      const id = detId('booking', `${bookingIdx}`)
      bookings.push({
        id,
        studio_id: ctx.studioId,
        client_id: clientId,
        artist_id: artistId,
        service_id: serviceId,
        location_id: locationId,
        scheduled_at: day.toISOString(),
        duration_min: svcHint.duration,
        status,
        price_cents: svcHint.price,
        deposit_cents: svcHint.deposit,
        deposit_paid: depositPaid,
        deposit_paid_at: depositPaid ? new Date(day.getTime() - 3 * 86400_000).toISOString() : null,
        balance_paid: balancePaid,
        balance_paid_at: balancePaid ? day.toISOString() : null,
        tip_cents: balancePaid ? faker.number.int({ min: 0, max: 8000 }) : 0,
        source: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['internal', 'public', 'public', 'waitlist']),
        notes: faker.helpers.maybe(() => faker.lorem.sentence({ min: 6, max: 10 }), { probability: 0.3 }) ?? null,
        project_id: projectId,
        session_number: sessionNumber,
        cancelled_at: status === 'cancelled' ? new Date(day.getTime() - 2 * 86400_000).toISOString() : null,
        cancellation_reason:
          status === 'cancelled'
            ? faker.helpers.arrayElement(['client_requested', 'scheduling_conflict', 'illness'])
            : null,
        cancelled_by: status === 'cancelled' ? DEMO_USERS.recept1.id : null,
        consent_required: true,
        consent_signed_at: status === 'completed' ? new Date(day.getTime() - 1 * 3600_000).toISOString() : null,
      })
      bookingIdx++
    }
  }

  // Upsert bookings in chunks of 100 to stay under PostgREST limits
  for (let i = 0; i < bookings.length; i += 100) {
    const chunk = bookings.slice(i, i + 100)
    const { error } = await sb.from('bookings').upsert(chunk, { onConflict: 'id' })
    if (error) throw new Error(`[bookings] bookings upsert chunk ${i}: ${error.message}`)
  }
  log.module('bookings', bookings.length, 'bookings')
  ctx.bookingIds = bookings.map((b) => b.id)
  ctx.completedBookingIds = bookings.filter((b) => b.status === 'completed').map((b) => b.id)

  // 3. Booking photos — 2 per completed booking
  const photoRows: Array<{
    id: string
    studio_id: string
    booking_id: string
    client_id: string
    storage_path: string
    kind: 'reference' | 'before' | 'during' | 'after' | 'healed'
    caption: string | null
    uploaded_by: string
    taken_at: string
  }> = []
  bookings
    .filter((b) => b.status === 'completed')
    .slice(0, 30)
    .forEach((b) => {
      ;(['before', 'after'] as const).forEach((kind) => {
        photoRows.push({
          id: detId('booking_photo', `${b.id}:${kind}`),
          studio_id: ctx.studioId,
          booking_id: b.id,
          client_id: b.client_id,
          storage_path: `booking-photos/demo/${b.id}/${kind}.jpg`,
          kind,
          caption: kind === 'before' ? 'Reference mockup' : 'Session complete',
          uploaded_by: DEMO_USERS.artist1.id,
          taken_at: b.scheduled_at,
        })
      })
    })
  for (let i = 0; i < photoRows.length; i += 100) {
    const chunk = photoRows.slice(i, i + 100)
    const { error } = await sb.from('booking_photos').upsert(chunk, { onConflict: 'id' })
    if (error) throw new Error(`[bookings] booking_photos upsert chunk ${i}: ${error.message}`)
  }
  log.module('bookings', photoRows.length, 'booking_photos')
}

import type { AdminClient } from '../client'
import type { DemoContext } from '../context'
import { detId, faker, type Json } from '../rng'
import { log } from '../log'

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  const tattooTemplate = ctx.consentTemplateIds[0]!
  const piercingTemplate = ctx.consentTemplateIds[1]!

  // Fetch completed bookings to link consent submissions
  const { data: bookings } = await sb
    .from('bookings')
    .select('id, client_id, scheduled_at')
    .eq('studio_id', ctx.studioId)
    .eq('status', 'completed')
    .in('id', ctx.completedBookingIds.length > 0 ? ctx.completedBookingIds : ['never'])
    .limit(18)

  // 1. Consent form submissions — 15 signed + some pending request rows
  type Sub = {
    id: string
    studio_id: string
    template_id: string
    template_version: number
    template_snapshot: Json
    booking_id: string | null
    client_id: string
    signer_name: string
    signer_email: string | null
    signer_phone: string | null
    answers: Json
    signature_path: string
    signature_svg: string | null
    signed_at: string
    ip_address: string | null
    geo_country: string | null
  }
  const submissions: Sub[] = []
  ;(bookings ?? []).slice(0, 15).forEach((b, i) => {
    const name = faker.person.fullName()
    submissions.push({
      id: detId('consent_submission', b.id),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      template_id: i % 5 === 0 ? piercingTemplate : tattooTemplate,
      template_version: 1,
      template_snapshot: { sections: [] },
      booking_id: b.id,
      client_id: b.client_id,
      signer_name: name,
      signer_email: faker.internet.email({ firstName: name.split(' ')[0] }).toLowerCase(),
      signer_phone: `+1 415 555 ${String(2000 + i).slice(-4)}`,
      answers: { allergies: 'None disclosed', medications: 'None' },
      signature_path: `consent/demo/${b.id}.svg`,
      signature_svg: '<svg/>',
      signed_at: new Date(new Date(b.scheduled_at).getTime() - 3600_000).toISOString(),
      ip_address: '10.0.0.1',
      geo_country: 'US',
    })
  })
  for (let i = 0; i < submissions.length; i += 50) {
    const chunk = submissions.slice(i, i + 50)
    const { error } = await sb.from('consent_form_submissions').upsert(chunk, { onConflict: 'id' })
    if (error) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_form_submissions upsert chunk ${i}: ${error.message}`)
  }
  log.module('consent', submissions.length, 'consent_form_submissions')

  // 2. Consent form requests — pending requests not yet signed
  const pendingCandidates = ctx.clientIds.slice(15, 22)
  const requestRows = pendingCandidates.map((clientId, i) => ({
    id: detId('consent_request', `${clientId}:${i}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    template_id: tattooTemplate,
    booking_id: null,
    client_id: clientId,
    sent_to_email: `client-${i}@demo.test`,
    status: i === 0 ? ('opened' as const) : ('pending' as const),
    sent_at: new Date(Date.now() - (3 + i) * 86400_000).toISOString(),
    opened_at: i === 0 ? new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 86400_000).toISOString() : null,
    expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
  }))
  const { error: reqErr } = await sb.from('consent_form_requests').upsert(requestRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (reqErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_form_requests upsert: ${reqErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', requestRows.length, 'consent_form_requests')

  // 3. Consent auto-send rules — 3 defaults
  const autoRules = [
    { trigger: 'any_booking' as const, timing: 'immediately' as const, timing_value: 0 },
    { trigger: 'first_time_client' as const, timing: 'hours_before_session' as const, timing_value: 48 },
    { trigger: 'session_complete' as const, timing: 'minutes_after_complete' as const, timing_value: 30 },
  ]
  const autoRows = autoRules.map((r, i) => ({
    id: detId('consent_auto_rule', `${r.trigger}:${i}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    trigger: r.trigger,
    template_id: tattooTemplate,
    timing: r.timing,
    timing_value: r.timing_value,
    channels: ['email', 'sms'] as const,
    enabled: true,
    is_default: true,
  }))
  const { error: arErr } = await sb.from('consent_auto_send_rules').upsert(autoRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (arErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_auto_send_rules upsert: ${arErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', autoRows.length, 'consent_auto_send_rules')

  // 4. Kiosk session — 1 active
  const { error: kErr } = await sb.from('consent_kiosk_sessions').upsert(
    {
      id: detId('consent_kiosk', 'primary'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      kiosk_token: 'demo-kiosk-token-' + ctx.studioId.slice(0, 8),
      template_id: tattooTemplate,
      enabled: true,
      last_rotated_at: new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
    },
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (kErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_kiosk_sessions upsert: ${kErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', 1, 'consent_kiosk_sessions')

  // 5. Studio ink registry — 8 entries (used by REACH)
  const brands = ['Eternal', 'Dynamic', 'World Famous', 'Intenze', 'Fusion', 'Solid', 'Eclipse', 'Quantum']
  const colors = ['True Black', 'Rich Red', 'Ocean Blue', 'Pure White', 'Bold Yellow', 'Forest Green', 'Hot Pink', 'Deep Purple']
  const inkRegistryRows = brands.slice(0, 8).map((brand, i) => ({
    id: detId('studio_ink_registry', `${brand}:${colors[i]}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    brand,
    color: colors[i]!,
    product_code: `${brand.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}-${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    batch_number: `B${new Date().getFullYear()}${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    manufacture_date: new Date(Date.now() - 180 * 86400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    expiry_date: new Date(Date.now() + (365 - i * 30) * 86400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    reach_compliant: i !== 7,  // last one non-compliant for demo
    sds_url: `https://reach-compliance.demo/sds/${brand.toLowerCase()}-${i}.pdf`,
    supplier_id: ctx.supplierIds[i % ctx.supplierIds.length] ?? null,
    is_active: true,
  }))
  const { error: sirErr } = await sb.from('studio_ink_registry').upsert(inkRegistryRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (sirErr) throw new Error(`[consent] studio_ink_registry upsert: ${sirErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', inkRegistryRows.length, 'studio_ink_registry')

  // 6. REACH ink records — link used inks to completed bookings
  const reachRows = (bookings ?? []).slice(0, 8).map((b, i) => {
    const ink = inkRegistryRows[i % inkRegistryRows.length]!
    return {
      id: detId('reach_ink', `${b.id}:${i}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      submission_id: detId('consent_submission', b.id),
      booking_id: b.id,
      ink_brand: ink.brand,
      ink_color: ink.color,
      ink_product_code: ink.product_code,
      batch_number: ink.batch_number,
      manufacture_date: ink.manufacture_date,
      expiry_date: ink.expiry_date,
      reach_compliant: ink.reach_compliant,
      reach_compliance_source: (ink.reach_compliant ? 'verified' : 'unverified') as 'verified' | 'artist_claimed' | 'unverified',
      sds_url: ink.sds_url,
      used_at: b.scheduled_at,
    }
  })
  const { error: rErr } = await sb.from('reach_ink_records').upsert(reachRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (rErr) throw new Error(`[consent] reach_ink_records upsert: ${rErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', reachRows.length, 'reach_ink_records')
}

    trigger: r.trigger,
    template_id: tattooTemplate,
    timing: r.timing,
    timing_value: r.timing_value,
    channels: ['email', 'sms'] as const,
    enabled: true,
    is_default: true,
  }))
  const { error: arErr } = await sb.from('consent_auto_send_rules').upsert(autoRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (arErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_auto_send_rules upsert: ${arErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', autoRows.length, 'consent_auto_send_rules')

  // 4. Kiosk session — 1 active
  const { error: kErr } = await sb.from('consent_kiosk_sessions').upsert(
    {
      id: detId('consent_kiosk', 'primary'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      kiosk_token: 'demo-kiosk-token-' + ctx.studioId.slice(0, 8),
      template_id: tattooTemplate,
      enabled: true,
      last_rotated_at: new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
    },
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (kErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_kiosk_sessions upsert: ${kErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', 1, 'consent_kiosk_sessions')

  // 5. Studio ink registry — 8 entries (used by REACH)
  const brands = ['Eternal', 'Dynamic', 'World Famous', 'Intenze', 'Fusion', 'Solid', 'Eclipse', 'Quantum']
  const colors = ['True Black', 'Rich Red', 'Ocean Blue', 'Pure White', 'Bold Yellow', 'Forest Green', 'Hot Pink', 'Deep Purple']
  const inkRegistryRows = brands.slice(0, 8).map((brand, i) => ({
    id: detId('studio_ink_registry', `${brand}:${colors[i]}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    brand,
    color: colors[i]!,
    product_code: `${brand.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}-${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    batch_number: `B${new Date().getFullYear()}${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    manufacture_date: new Date(Date.now() - 180 * 86400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    expiry_date: new Date(Date.now() + (365 - i * 30) * 86400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    reach_compliant: i !== 7,  // last one non-compliant for demo
    sds_url: `https://reach-compliance.demo/sds/${brand.toLowerCase()}-${i}.pdf`,
    supplier_id: ctx.supplierIds[i % ctx.supplierIds.length] ?? null,
    is_active: true,
  }))
  const { error: sirErr } = await sb.from('studio_ink_registry').upsert(inkRegistryRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (sirErr) throw new Error(`[consent] studio_ink_registry upsert: ${sirErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', inkRegistryRows.length, 'studio_ink_registry')

  // 6. REACH ink records — link used inks to completed bookings
  const reachRows = (bookings ?? []).slice(0, 8).map((b, i) => {
    const ink = inkRegistryRows[i % inkRegistryRows.length]!
    return {
      id: detId('reach_ink', `${b.id}:${i}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      submission_id: detId('consent_submission', b.id),
      booking_id: b.id,
      ink_brand: ink.brand,
      ink_color: ink.color,
      ink_product_code: ink.product_code,
      batch_number: ink.batch_number,
      manufacture_date: ink.manufacture_date,
      expiry_date: ink.expiry_date,
      reach_compliant: ink.reach_compliant,
      reach_compliance_source: (ink.reach_compliant ? 'verified' : 'unverified') as 'verified' | 'artist_claimed' | 'unverified',
      sds_url: ink.sds_url,
      used_at: b.scheduled_at,
    }
  })
  const { error: rErr } = await sb.from('reach_ink_records').upsert(reachRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (rErr) throw new Error(`[consent] reach_ink_records upsert: ${rErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', reachRows.length, 'reach_ink_records')
}

import type { AdminClient } from '../client'
import type { DemoContext } from '../context'
import { asJson, detId } from '../rng'
import { log } from '../log'
import { DEMO_LOC_A, DEMO_LOC_B, DEMO_STUDIO_ID, DEMO_STUDIO_NAME, DEMO_STUDIO_SLUG } from '../constants'

const ALL_FEATURES = [
  'booking',
  'calendar',
  'public_booking_page',
  'digital_consent',
  'client_crm',
  'dodo_payments',
  'custom_domain',
  'inventory',
  'commissions',
  'sms_reminders',
  'marketing_basic',
  'marketing_advanced',
  'calendar_sync',
  'referral_program',
  'omnichannel_inbox',
  'messaging_ai_replies',
  'projects',
  'payroll',
  'ai_design',
  'ai_design_assistant',
  'guest_artists',
  'eu_reach',
  'multi_location',
  'analytics',
  'white_label',
  'api_access',
] as const

const STUDIO_PLUS = ALL_FEATURES.slice(0, 17)
const PRO_PLUS = ALL_FEATURES.slice(0, 24)
const SOLO = ALL_FEATURES.slice(0, 7)

const PLANS: Array<{
  id: string
  tier: 'solo' | 'studio' | 'pro' | 'enterprise'
  display_name: string
  price_cents: number
  features: readonly string[]
  sort_order: number
}> = [
  { id: detId('plan', 'solo'),       tier: 'solo',       display_name: 'Solo',       price_cents: 2900,  features: SOLO,          sort_order: 10 },
  { id: detId('plan', 'studio'),     tier: 'studio',     display_name: 'Studio',     price_cents: 5900,  features: STUDIO_PLUS,   sort_order: 20 },
  { id: detId('plan', 'pro'),        tier: 'pro',        display_name: 'Pro',        price_cents: 9900,  features: PRO_PLUS,      sort_order: 30 },
  { id: detId('plan', 'enterprise'), tier: 'enterprise', display_name: 'Enterprise', price_cents: 19900, features: ALL_FEATURES,  sort_order: 40 },
]

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  // 1. Plans (global, not studio-scoped)
  const { error: planErr } = await sb.from('plans').upsert(
    PLANS.map((p) => ({
      id: p.id,
      tier: p.tier,
      billing_cycle: 'monthly' as const,
      dodo_product_id: `demo_${p.tier}_monthly`,
      display_name: p.display_name,
      price_cents: p.price_cents,
      currency: 'USD',
      features: asJson([...p.features]),
      sort_order: p.sort_order,
      is_active: true,
    })),
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (planErr) throw new Error(`[studio] plans upsert: ${planErr.message}`)
  log.module('studio', PLANS.length, 'plans')

  // 2. Studio (enterprise, fully unlocked)
  const enterprisePlanId = PLANS.find((p) => p.tier === 'enterprise')!.id
  const { error: studioErr } = await sb.from('studios').upsert(
    {
      id: DEMO_STUDIO_ID,
      name: DEMO_STUDIO_NAME,
      slug: DEMO_STUDIO_SLUG,
      timezone: 'America/Los_Angeles',
      locale: 'en-US',
      currency: 'USD',
      brand_color: '#B23A2B',
      plan_id: enterprisePlanId,
      status: 'active' as const,
      white_label_enabled: true,
      powered_by_hidden: false,
      deposit_deadline_hours: 48,
      require_intake_before_booking: false,
      intake_timing: 'pre_booking' as const,
      messaging_tone: 'casual' as const,
      messaging_connected_channels: ['email', 'sms'],
    },
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (studioErr) throw new Error(`[studio] studios upsert: ${studioErr.message}`)
  log.module('studio', 1, 'studios')

  // 3. Locations (2: primary + secondary)
  const { error: locErr } = await sb.from('locations').upsert(
    [
      {
        id: DEMO_LOC_A,
        studio_id: DEMO_STUDIO_ID,
        name: 'Downtown Flagship',
        address: '814 Mission St',
        city: 'San Francisco',
        state: 'CA',
        country: 'US',
        zip: '94103',
        phone: '+1 415 555 0101',
        timezone: 'America/Los_Angeles',
        is_primary: true,
        status: 'active' as const,
        opening_hours: {
          mon: { open: '11:00', close: '20:00' },
          tue: { open: '11:00', close: '20:00' },
          wed: { open: '11:00', close: '20:00' },
          thu: { open: '11:00', close: '22:00' },
          fri: { open: '11:00', close: '22:00' },
          sat: { open: '10:00', close: '22:00' },
          sun: { open: '12:00', close: '18:00' },
        },
        description: 'Flagship location with six chairs and a private consult room.',
        social_instagram: 'inkhaus.sf',
        sort_order: 0,
      },
      {
        id: DEMO_LOC_B,
        studio_id: DEMO_STUDIO_ID,
        name: 'Mission Studio',
        address: '2121 Mission St',
        city: 'San Francisco',
        state: 'CA',
        country: 'US',
        zip: '94110',
        phone: '+1 415 555 0202',
        timezone: 'America/Los_Angeles',
        is_primary: false,
        status: 'active' as const,
        opening_hours: {
          mon: { open: '12:00', close: '20:00' },
          tue: { open: '12:00', close: '20:00' },
          wed: { open: '12:00', close: '20:00' },
          thu: { open: '12:00', close: '20:00' },
          fri: { open: '12:00', close: '21:00' },
          sat: { open: '10:00', close: '21:00' },
          sun: { open: '12:00', close: '18:00' },
        },
        description: 'Second location focusing on fine-line and walk-ins.',
        social_instagram: 'inkhaus.mission',
        sort_order: 1,
      },
    ],
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (locErr) throw new Error(`[studio] locations upsert: ${locErr.message}`)
  log.module('studio', 2, 'locations')

  // 4. Subscription — active enterprise
  const now = new Date()
  const periodStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1)
  const periodEnd = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 1)
  const trialStart = new Date(now.getTime() - 90 * 86400_000)
  const { error: subErr } = await sb.from('subscriptions').upsert(
    {
      id: detId('subscription', 'primary'),
      studio_id: DEMO_STUDIO_ID,
      dodo_subscription_id: 'sub_demo_enterprise',
      dodo_customer_id: 'cus_demo_studio',
      plan_tier: 'enterprise' as const,
      billing_cycle: 'monthly' as const,
      status: 'active' as const,
      trial_start: trialStart.toISOString(),
      trial_end: new Date(trialStart.getTime() + 14 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      current_period_start: periodStart.toISOString(),
      current_period_end: periodEnd.toISOString(),
      cancel_at_period_end: false,
      price_cents: 19900,
      currency: 'USD',
      quantity: 1,
      metadata: asJson({ demo: true }),
    },
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (subErr) throw new Error(`[studio] subscriptions upsert: ${subErr.message}`)
  log.module('studio', 1, 'subscriptions')

  // 5. Domain verification
  const { error: domErr } = await sb.from('domain_verifications').upsert(
    {
      id: detId('domain', 'primary'),
      studio_id: DEMO_STUDIO_ID,
      domain: 'book.inkhaus-demo.com',
      verified: true,
      verified_at: new Date(now.getTime() - 30 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      last_checked_at: now.toISOString(),
    },
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (domErr) throw new Error(`[studio] domain_verifications upsert: ${domErr.message}`)
  log.module('studio', 1, 'domain_verifications')

  // 6. Usage meters (current period)
  const meters: Array<{
    meter: 'sms_sent' | 'ai_generations' | 'bookings_created' | 'active_artists' | 'active_locations' | 'storage_mb'
    used: number
    quota: number
  }> = [
    { meter: 'sms_sent',         used: 247, quota: 2000 },
    { meter: 'ai_generations',   used: 62,  quota: 500 },
    { meter: 'bookings_created', used: 38,  quota: 1000 },
    { meter: 'active_artists',   used: 4,   quota: 25 },
    { meter: 'active_locations', used: 2,   quota: 10 },
    { meter: 'storage_mb',       used: 420, quota: 10240 },
  ]
  const { error: meterErr } = await sb.from('usage_meters').upsert(
    meters.map((m) => ({
      id: detId('usage_meter', `${m.meter}-${periodStart.toISOString().slice(0, 7)}`),
      studio_id: DEMO_STUDIO_ID,
      period_start: periodStart.toISOString(),
      period_end: periodEnd.toISOString(),
      meter: m.meter,
      used: m.used,
      quota: m.quota,
      overage_cents: 0,
    })),
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (meterErr) throw new Error(`[studio] usage_meters upsert: ${meterErr.message}`)
  log.module('studio', meters.length, 'usage_meters')

  // 7. Feature flags (studio-level overrides)
  const flags = [
    { flag_key: 'new_calendar_ui',      enabled: true },
    { flag_key: 'inbox_v2',             enabled: true },
    { flag_key: 'ai_design_beta',       enabled: true },
    { flag_key: 'eu_reach_compliance',  enabled: true },
  ]
  const { error: flagErr } = await sb.from('feature_flags').upsert(
    flags.map((f) => ({
      id: detId('feature_flag', f.flag_key),
      studio_id: DEMO_STUDIO_ID,
      flag_key: f.flag_key,
      enabled: f.enabled,
      reason: 'Demo studio — all betas enabled',
    })),
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (flagErr) throw new Error(`[studio] feature_flags upsert: ${flagErr.message}`)
  log.module('studio', flags.length, 'feature_flags')

  // 8. System announcement (global)
  const { error: annErr } = await sb.from('system_announcements').upsert(
    {
      id: detId('announcement', 'demo-banner'),
      title: 'Welcome to the InkOS demo',
      body: 'Every feature is populated with realistic data. Re-seed anytime with `pnpm db:seed:demo`.',
      type: 'info' as const,
      is_active: true,
      starts_at: new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      ends_at: new Date(now.getTime() + 30 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      target_plans: null,
    },
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (annErr) throw new Error(`[studio] announcements upsert: ${annErr.message}`)
  log.module('studio', 1, 'system_announcements')

  ctx.studioId = DEMO_STUDIO_ID
  ctx.locations = { primary: DEMO_LOC_A, secondary: DEMO_LOC_B }
}

        address: '814 Mission St',
        city: 'San Francisco',
        state: 'CA',
        country: 'US',
        zip: '94103',
        phone: '+1 415 555 0101',
        timezone: 'America/Los_Angeles',
        is_primary: true,
        status: 'active' as const,

          fri: { open: '11:00', close: '22:00' },
          sat: { open: '10:00', close: '22:00' },
          sun: { open: '12:00', close: '18:00' },

        social_instagram: 'inkhaus.sf',
        sort_order: 0,

      {
        id: DEMO_LOC_B,
        studio_id: DEMO_STUDIO_ID,
        name: 'Mission Studio',
        address: '2121 Mission St',
        city: 'San Francisco',
        state: 'CA',
        country: 'US',
        zip: '94110',
        phone: '+1 415 555 0202',
        timezone: 'America/Los_Angeles',
        is_primary: false,
        status: 'active' as const,
        opening_hours: {
          mon: { open: '12:00', close: '20:00' },
          tue: { open: '12:00', close: '20:00' },
          wed: { open: '12:00', close: '20:00' },
          thu: { open: '12:00', close: '20:00' },
          fri: { open: '12:00', close: '21:00' },
          sat: { open: '10:00', close: '21:00' },
          sun: { open: '12:00', close: '18:00' },

import type { DemoContext } from '../context'

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {

  const serviceRows = SERVICES.map((s, i) => ({

    description: `${s.name} — demo offering.`,
    duration_min: s.duration,

    deposit_cents: s.deposit,

    buffer_before_min: 10,
    buffer_after_min: 15,
    requires_consultation: s.slug === 'full-sleeve' || s.slug === 'half-sleeve',

    sort_order: i,
    color: s.color,
    category: s.category,

  if (sErr) throw new Error(`[catalog] services upsert: ${sErr.message}`)
  log.module('catalog', serviceRows.length, 'services')
  ctx.serviceIds = serviceRows.map((r) => r.id)

  // 2. service_artists — each active artist can do most services
  const serviceArtistRows: Array<{ service_id: string; artist_id: string }> = []

    }

    onConflict: 'service_id,artist_id',

  if (saErr) throw new Error(`[catalog] service_artists upsert: ${saErr.message}`)
  log.module('catalog', serviceArtistRows.length, 'service_artists')

  // 3. Style tags
  const tagRows = STYLE_TAGS.map((t, i) => ({
    id: detId('style_tag', t.slug),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    slug: t.slug,
    name: t.name,
    color: t.color,
    sort_order: i,
  }))
  const { error: tErr } = await sb.from('style_tags').upsert(tagRows, { onConflict: 'studio_id,slug' })

  log.module('catalog', tagRows.length, 'style_tags')

  // 4. Booking page settings
  const firstFeatured = serviceRows.slice(0, 4).map((s) => s.id)
  const { error: bpErr } = await sb.from('booking_page_settings').upsert(
    {
      id: detId('booking_page_settings', 'primary'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      intro_headline: 'Book a chair at Inkhaus',
      intro_body: 'Resident artists, guest residencies, and walk-in Sundays. Deposits held securely via Dodo.',
      featured_service_ids: firstFeatured,
      show_artist_profiles: true,
      show_prices: true,
      require_deposit_on_public: true,
      lead_time_hours: 24,
      cancellation_policy: '48-hour notice required. Deposits are non-refundable inside 24h.',
      aftercare_message: 'Keep the bandage on for 4 hours. Wash with unscented soap. Moisturize twice daily.',
    },
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )

  const templateRows = [
    {
      id: detId('consent_template', 'tattoo'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      name: 'Tattoo Consent & Release',
      slug: 'tattoo-consent',
      kind: 'tattoo' as const,
      version: 1,
      is_active: true,
      is_default: true,
      sections: asJson([

        { type: 'textarea', name: 'allergies', label: 'Allergies or skin conditions' },
        { type: 'heading', value: 'Consent' },
        { type: 'signature', name: 'signature', label: 'Signature' },
      ]),
      applicable_services: null,
      required_for_booking: true,
      retention_years: 7,
      language: 'en',
      created_by: DEMO_USERS.owner.id,
    },
    {
      id: detId('consent_template', 'piercing'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      name: 'Piercing Consent',
      slug: 'piercing-consent',
      kind: 'piercing' as const,
      version: 1,
      is_active: true,
      is_default: false,
      sections: asJson([
        { type: 'heading', value: 'Aftercare Commitment' },
        { type: 'signature', name: 'signature', label: 'Signature' },
      ]),
      applicable_services: null,
      required_for_booking: true,
      retention_years: 5,
      language: 'en',
      created_by: DEMO_USERS.owner.id,
    },
    {
      id: detId('consent_template', 'minor'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      name: 'Minor Consent (with Guardian)',
      slug: 'minor-consent',
      kind: 'minor' as const,
      version: 1,
      is_active: true,
      is_default: false,
      sections: asJson([
        { type: 'heading', value: 'Guardian Acknowledgement' },
        { type: 'signature', name: 'guardian_signature', label: 'Guardian signature' },
      ]),
      applicable_services: null,
      required_for_booking: true,
      requires_guardian: true,
      retention_years: 10,
      language: 'en',
      created_by: DEMO_USERS.owner.id,
    },
  ]
  const { error: ctErr } = await sb.from('consent_form_templates').upsert(templateRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (ctErr) throw new Error(`[catalog] consent_form_templates upsert: ${ctErr.message}`)
  log.module('catalog', templateRows.length, 'consent_form_templates')
  ctx.consentTemplateIds = templateRows.map((r) => r.id)

  // 6. Message templates (5 core)
  const msgTemplates = [
    { slug: 'aftercare',     name: 'Aftercare',             category: 'aftercare'    as const, channel: 'email' as const,
      body: 'Keep the bandage on for 4 hours. Wash with unscented soap. Moisturize twice daily.', keywords: ['aftercare', 'care'] },
    { slug: 'deposit-link',  name: 'Deposit Link',          category: 'deposit'      as const, channel: 'both'  as const,

      body: 'You are booked with {{artist}} on {{date}} at {{time}}.', keywords: [] },

      body: 'Need to reschedule? Pick a new time here: {{reschedule_link}}', keywords: ['reschedule'] },
    { slug: 'inquiry-reply', name: 'New Inquiry Auto-reply', category: 'inquiry_reply' as const, channel: 'sms'  as const,

  ]
  const msgTemplateRows = msgTemplates.map((t) => ({

    category: t.category,
    trigger_keywords: t.keywords,
    is_default: true,
    created_by: DEMO_USERS.owner.id,
  }))
  const { error: mtErr } = await sb.from('message_templates').upsert(msgTemplateRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (mtErr) throw new Error(`[catalog] message_templates upsert: ${mtErr.message}`)
  log.module('catalog', msgTemplateRows.length, 'message_templates')
}

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  // 1. Services
  const serviceRows = SERVICES.map((s, i) => ({
    id: detId('service', s.slug),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    name: s.name,
    slug: s.slug,
    description: `${s.name} — demo offering.`,
    duration_min: s.duration,
    base_price_cents: s.price,
    deposit_cents: s.deposit,
    deposit_required: s.deposit > 0,
    buffer_before_min: 10,
    buffer_after_min: 15,
    requires_consultation: s.slug === 'full-sleeve' || s.slug === 'half-sleeve',
    is_public: s.slug !== 'touch-up',
    sort_order: i,
    color: s.color,
    category: s.category,
  }))
  const { error: sErr } = await sb.from('services').upsert(serviceRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (sErr) throw new Error(`[catalog] services upsert: ${sErr.message}`)
  log.module('catalog', serviceRows.length, 'services')
  ctx.serviceIds = serviceRows.map((r) => r.id)

  // 2. service_artists — each active artist can do most services
  const serviceArtistRows: Array<{ service_id: string; artist_id: string }> = []
  for (const artistId of ctx.artistIds) {
    for (const s of serviceRows) {
      serviceArtistRows.push({ service_id: s.id, artist_id: artistId })
    }
  }
  const { error: saErr } = await sb.from('service_artists').upsert(serviceArtistRows, {
    onConflict: 'service_id,artist_id',
  })
  if (saErr) throw new Error(`[catalog] service_artists upsert: ${saErr.message}`)
  log.module('catalog', serviceArtistRows.length, 'service_artists')

  // 3. Style tags
  const tagRows = STYLE_TAGS.map((t, i) => ({
    id: detId('style_tag', t.slug),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    slug: t.slug,
    name: t.name,
    color: t.color,
    sort_order: i,
  }))
  const { error: tErr } = await sb.from('style_tags').upsert(tagRows, { onConflict: 'studio_id,slug' })
  if (tErr) throw new Error(`[catalog] style_tags upsert: ${tErr.message}`)
  log.module('catalog', tagRows.length, 'style_tags')

  // 4. Booking page settings
  const firstFeatured = serviceRows.slice(0, 4).map((s) => s.id)

      studio_id: ctx.studioId,

      require_deposit_on_public: true,
      lead_time_hours: 24,

    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (bpErr) throw new Error(`[catalog] booking_page_settings upsert: ${bpErr.message}`)
  log.module('catalog', 1, 'booking_page_settings')

  // 5. Consent form templates (3 core kinds)
  const templateRows = [
    {
      id: detId('consent_template', 'tattoo'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,

      language: 'en',

    },
  ]
  const { error: ctErr } = await sb.from('consent_form_templates').upsert(templateRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (ctErr) throw new Error(`[catalog] consent_form_templates upsert: ${ctErr.message}`)
  log.module('catalog', templateRows.length, 'consent_form_templates')
  ctx.consentTemplateIds = templateRows.map((r) => r.id)

  // 6. Message templates (5 core)

15	  from: (table: 'client_tags') => {
16	    select: (columns: string) => {
17	      eq: (column: string, value: string) => {
18	        order: (column: string) => Promise<{ data: ClientTag[] | null; error: unknown }>
19	      }

21	    insert: (rows: Array<{
22	      studio_id: string

24	      color: ClientTag['color']
25	      icon: null

30	export async function ensureDefaultClientTags(
31	  supabase: ClientTagsSupabase,
32	  studioId: string,
33	  existingTags: ClientTag[],
34	): Promise<ClientTag[]> {
35	  const existingNames = new Set(existingTags.map((tag) => tag.name.toLowerCase()))
36	  const missingTags = DEFAULT_CLIENT_TAGS.filter(
37	    (tag) => !existingNames.has(tag.name.toLowerCase()),
38	  )
39	
40	  if (missingTags.length === 0) return existingTags
41	
42	  const { error } = await supabase.from('client_tags').insert(
43	    missingTags.map((tag) => ({
44	      studio_id: studioId,
45	      name: tag.name,
46	      color: tag.color,
47	      icon: tag.icon,
48	    })),
49	  )
50	
51	  if (error && error.code !== '23505') {
52	    return existingTags
53	  }
54	
55	  const { data } = await supabase
56	    .from('client_tags')
57	    .select('id, name, color, icon')

import type { AdminClient } from '../client'
import type { DemoContext } from '../context'
import { detId, faker, weighted } from '../rng'
import { log } from '../log'
import { DEMO_USERS } from '../constants'

const PAST_DAYS = 60
const FUTURE_DAYS = 30

type BookingStatus = 'pending' | 'confirmed' | 'in_progress' | 'completed' | 'cancelled' | 'no_show'

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  const today = new Date()
  today.setHours(12, 0, 0, 0)

  // 1. Projects — 4 multi-session projects (for 4 clients)
  const projectRows = Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => {
    const client = ctx.clientIds[i]!
    const artist = ctx.artistIds[i % ctx.artistIds.length]!
    return {
      id: detId('project', `${i}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      client_id: client,
      primary_artist_id: artist,
      name: faker.helpers.arrayElement([
        'Dragon Half-Sleeve',
        'Botanical Back Piece',
        'Abstract Chest Panel',
        'Geometric Forearm Wrap',
      ]),
      description: faker.lorem.sentence({ min: 12, max: 20 }),
      placement: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['left_forearm', 'upper_back', 'chest', 'right_sleeve']),
      style: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['black_and_grey', 'color', 'neo_traditional']),
      status: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['planning', 'active', 'active', 'healing'] as const),
      total_sessions_planned: faker.number.int({ min: 3, max: 6 }),
      total_price_cents: faker.number.int({ min: 150000, max: 400000 }),
      deposit_pool_cents: 30000,
      deposit_applied_cents: 0,
      size: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['small', 'medium', 'large', 'xl']),
      color_mode: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['black_and_grey', 'color']),
      deposit_apply_rule: 'first_session',
      secondary_artist_ids: [] as string[],
      style_tags: [] as string[],
      sessions_completed: 1,
      started_at: new Date(today.getTime() - 45 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
    }
  })
  const { error: pErr } = await sb.from('projects').upsert(projectRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (pErr) throw new Error(`[bookings] projects upsert: ${pErr.message}`)
  log.module('bookings', projectRows.length, 'projects')
  ctx.projectIds = projectRows.map((r) => r.id)

  // 2. Bookings — past 60d + future 30d, mixed statuses
  type BookingRow = {
    id: string
    studio_id: string
    client_id: string
    artist_id: string
    service_id: string
    location_id: string
    scheduled_at: string
    duration_min: number
    status: BookingStatus
    price_cents: number
    deposit_cents: number
    deposit_paid: boolean
    deposit_paid_at: string | null
    balance_paid: boolean
    balance_paid_at: string | null
    tip_cents: number
    source: 'internal' | 'public' | 'waitlist' | 'import'
    notes: string | null
    project_id: string | null
    session_number: number | null
    cancelled_at: string | null
    cancellation_reason: string | null
    cancelled_by: string | null
    consent_required: boolean
    consent_signed_at: string | null
  }

  const bookings: BookingRow[] = []
  let bookingIdx = 0
  for (let dayOffset = -PAST_DAYS; dayOffset <= FUTURE_DAYS; dayOffset++) {
    const count = faker.number.int({ min: 0, max: 3 })
    for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
      const day = new Date(today)
      day.setDate(today.getDate() + dayOffset)
      day.setHours(faker.number.int({ min: 11, max: 18 }), faker.helpers.arrayElement([0, 30]), 0, 0)

      const isPast = dayOffset < 0
      const isToday = dayOffset === 0
      const status: BookingStatus = isPast
        ? weighted<BookingStatus>([
            ['completed', 75],
            ['cancelled', 10],
            ['no_show', 8],
            ['confirmed', 7], // past confirmed but never marked complete
          ])
        : isToday
        ? weighted<BookingStatus>([
            ['in_progress', 20],
            ['confirmed', 55],
            ['completed', 20],
            ['pending', 5],
          ])
        : weighted<BookingStatus>([
            ['confirmed', 75],
            ['pending', 20],
            ['cancelled', 5],
          ])

      const serviceId = ctx.serviceIds[bookingIdx % ctx.serviceIds.length]!
      const artistId = ctx.artistIds[bookingIdx % ctx.artistIds.length]!
      const clientId = ctx.clientIds[bookingIdx % ctx.clientIds.length]!
      const locationId = bookingIdx % 3 === 0 ? ctx.locations.secondary : ctx.locations.primary

      const serviceHints: Array<{ price: number; deposit: number; duration: number }> = [
        { price: 22000, deposit: 10000, duration: 120 },
        { price: 65000, deposit: 20000, duration: 240 },
        { price: 95000, deposit: 30000, duration: 360 },
        { price: 18000, deposit: 8000, duration: 90 },
        { price: 0, deposit: 0, duration: 45 },
        { price: 0, deposit: 0, duration: 30 },
        { price: 7500, deposit: 2500, duration: 30 },
        { price: 12000, deposit: 5000, duration: 45 },
      ]
      const svcHint = serviceHints[bookingIdx % ctx.serviceIds.length]!

      const depositPaid = status !== 'pending' && status !== 'cancelled' && svcHint.deposit > 0
      const balancePaid = status === 'completed'

      // Project linkage — every 8th booking ties to a project
      const projectIdx = bookingIdx % 8 === 0 ? bookingIdx / 8 : null
      const projectId = projectIdx !== null && projectIdx < projectRows.length ? projectRows[projectIdx]!.id : null
      const sessionNumber = projectId ? ((bookingIdx % 4) + 1) : null

      const id = detId('booking', `${bookingIdx}`)
      bookings.push({
        id,
        studio_id: ctx.studioId,
        client_id: clientId,
        artist_id: artistId,
        service_id: serviceId,
        location_id: locationId,
        scheduled_at: day.toISOString(),
        duration_min: svcHint.duration,
        status,
        price_cents: svcHint.price,
        deposit_cents: svcHint.deposit,
        deposit_paid: depositPaid,
        deposit_paid_at: depositPaid ? new Date(day.getTime() - 3 * 86400_000).toISOString() : null,
        balance_paid: balancePaid,
        balance_paid_at: balancePaid ? day.toISOString() : null,
        tip_cents: balancePaid ? faker.number.int({ min: 0, max: 8000 }) : 0,
        source: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['internal', 'public', 'public', 'waitlist']),
        notes: faker.helpers.maybe(() => faker.lorem.sentence({ min: 6, max: 10 }), { probability: 0.3 }) ?? null,
        project_id: projectId,
        session_number: sessionNumber,
        cancelled_at: status === 'cancelled' ? new Date(day.getTime() - 2 * 86400_000).toISOString() : null,
        cancellation_reason:
          status === 'cancelled'
            ? faker.helpers.arrayElement(['client_requested', 'scheduling_conflict', 'illness'])
            : null,
        cancelled_by: status === 'cancelled' ? DEMO_USERS.recept1.id : null,
        consent_required: true,
        consent_signed_at: status === 'completed' ? new Date(day.getTime() - 1 * 3600_000).toISOString() : null,
      })
      bookingIdx++
    }
  }

  // Upsert bookings in chunks of 100 to stay under PostgREST limits
  for (let i = 0; i < bookings.length; i += 100) {
    const chunk = bookings.slice(i, i + 100)
    const { error } = await sb.from('bookings').upsert(chunk, { onConflict: 'id' })
    if (error) throw new Error(`[bookings] bookings upsert chunk ${i}: ${error.message}`)
  }
  log.module('bookings', bookings.length, 'bookings')
  ctx.bookingIds = bookings.map((b) => b.id)
  ctx.completedBookingIds = bookings.filter((b) => b.status === 'completed').map((b) => b.id)

  // 3. Booking photos — 2 per completed booking
  const photoRows: Array<{
    id: string
    studio_id: string
    booking_id: string
    client_id: string
    storage_path: string
    kind: 'reference' | 'before' | 'during' | 'after' | 'healed'
    caption: string | null
    uploaded_by: string
    taken_at: string
  }> = []
  bookings
    .filter((b) => b.status === 'completed')
    .slice(0, 30)
    .forEach((b) => {
      ;(['before', 'after'] as const).forEach((kind) => {
        photoRows.push({
          id: detId('booking_photo', `${b.id}:${kind}`),
          studio_id: ctx.studioId,
          booking_id: b.id,
          client_id: b.client_id,
          storage_path: `booking-photos/demo/${b.id}/${kind}.jpg`,
          kind,
          caption: kind === 'before' ? 'Reference mockup' : 'Session complete',
          uploaded_by: DEMO_USERS.artist1.id,
          taken_at: b.scheduled_at,
        })
      })
    })
  for (let i = 0; i < photoRows.length; i += 100) {
    const chunk = photoRows.slice(i, i + 100)
    const { error } = await sb.from('booking_photos').upsert(chunk, { onConflict: 'id' })
    if (error) throw new Error(`[bookings] booking_photos upsert chunk ${i}: ${error.message}`)
  }
  log.module('bookings', photoRows.length, 'booking_photos')
}

import type { AdminClient } from '../client'
import type { DemoContext } from '../context'
import { detId, faker, weighted } from '../rng'
import { log } from '../log'
import { DEMO_USERS } from '../constants'

const PAST_DAYS = 60
const FUTURE_DAYS = 30

type BookingStatus = 'pending' | 'confirmed' | 'in_progress' | 'completed' | 'cancelled' | 'no_show'

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  const today = new Date()
  today.setHours(12, 0, 0, 0)

  // 1. Projects — 4 multi-session projects (for 4 clients)
  const projectRows = Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => {
    const client = ctx.clientIds[i]!
    const artist = ctx.artistIds[i % ctx.artistIds.length]!
    return {
      id: detId('project', `${i}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      client_id: client,
      primary_artist_id: artist,
      name: faker.helpers.arrayElement([
        'Dragon Half-Sleeve',
        'Botanical Back Piece',
        'Abstract Chest Panel',
        'Geometric Forearm Wrap',
      ]),
      description: faker.lorem.sentence({ min: 12, max: 20 }),
      placement: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['left_forearm', 'upper_back', 'chest', 'right_sleeve']),
      style: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['black_and_grey', 'color', 'neo_traditional']),
      status: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['planning', 'active', 'active', 'healing'] as const),
      total_sessions_planned: faker.number.int({ min: 3, max: 6 }),
      total_price_cents: faker.number.int({ min: 150000, max: 400000 }),
      deposit_pool_cents: 30000,
      deposit_applied_cents: 0,
      size: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['small', 'medium', 'large', 'extra_large', 'full_sleeve', 'full_back']),
      color_mode: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['black_and_grey', 'color']),
      deposit_apply_rule: 'last_session',
      secondary_artist_ids: [] as string[],
      style_tags: [] as string[],
      sessions_completed: 1,
      started_at: new Date(today.getTime() - 45 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
    }
  })
  const { error: pErr } = await sb.from('projects').upsert(projectRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (pErr) throw new Error(`[bookings] projects upsert: ${pErr.message}`)
  log.module('bookings', projectRows.length, 'projects')
  ctx.projectIds = projectRows.map((r) => r.id)

  // 2. Bookings — past 60d + future 30d, mixed statuses
  type BookingRow = {
    id: string
    studio_id: string
    client_id: string
    artist_id: string
    service_id: string
    location_id: string
    scheduled_at: string
    duration_min: number
    status: BookingStatus
    price_cents: number
    deposit_cents: number
    deposit_paid: boolean
    deposit_paid_at: string | null
    balance_paid: boolean
    balance_paid_at: string | null
    tip_cents: number
    source: 'internal' | 'public' | 'waitlist' | 'import'
    notes: string | null
    project_id: string | null
    session_number: number | null
    cancelled_at: string | null
    cancellation_reason: string | null
    cancelled_by: string | null
    consent_required: boolean
    consent_signed_at: string | null
  }

  const bookings: BookingRow[] = []
  let bookingIdx = 0
  for (let dayOffset = -PAST_DAYS; dayOffset <= FUTURE_DAYS; dayOffset++) {
    const count = faker.number.int({ min: 0, max: 3 })
    for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
      const day = new Date(today)
      day.setDate(today.getDate() + dayOffset)
      day.setHours(faker.number.int({ min: 11, max: 18 }), faker.helpers.arrayElement([0, 30]), 0, 0)

      const isPast = dayOffset < 0
      const isToday = dayOffset === 0
      const status: BookingStatus = isPast
        ? weighted<BookingStatus>([
            ['completed', 75],
            ['cancelled', 10],
            ['no_show', 8],
            ['confirmed', 7], // past confirmed but never marked complete
          ])
        : isToday
        ? weighted<BookingStatus>([
            ['in_progress', 20],
            ['confirmed', 55],
            ['completed', 20],
            ['pending', 5],
          ])
        : weighted<BookingStatus>([
            ['confirmed', 75],
            ['pending', 20],
            ['cancelled', 5],
          ])

      const serviceId = ctx.serviceIds[bookingIdx % ctx.serviceIds.length]!
      const artistId = ctx.artistIds[bookingIdx % ctx.artistIds.length]!
      const clientId = ctx.clientIds[bookingIdx % ctx.clientIds.length]!
      const locationId = bookingIdx % 3 === 0 ? ctx.locations.secondary : ctx.locations.primary

      const serviceHints: Array<{ price: number; deposit: number; duration: number }> = [
        { price: 22000, deposit: 10000, duration: 120 },
        { price: 65000, deposit: 20000, duration: 240 },
        { price: 95000, deposit: 30000, duration: 360 },
        { price: 18000, deposit: 8000, duration: 90 },
        { price: 0, deposit: 0, duration: 45 },
        { price: 0, deposit: 0, duration: 30 },
        { price: 7500, deposit: 2500, duration: 30 },
        { price: 12000, deposit: 5000, duration: 45 },
      ]
      const svcHint = serviceHints[bookingIdx % ctx.serviceIds.length]!

      const depositPaid = status !== 'pending' && status !== 'cancelled' && svcHint.deposit > 0
      const balancePaid = status === 'completed'

      // Project linkage — every 8th booking ties to a project
      const projectIdx = bookingIdx % 8 === 0 ? bookingIdx / 8 : null
      const projectId = projectIdx !== null && projectIdx < projectRows.length ? projectRows[projectIdx]!.id : null
      const sessionNumber = projectId ? ((bookingIdx % 4) + 1) : null

      const id = detId('booking', `${bookingIdx}`)
      bookings.push({
        id,
        studio_id: ctx.studioId,
        client_id: clientId,
        artist_id: artistId,
        service_id: serviceId,
        location_id: locationId,
        scheduled_at: day.toISOString(),
        duration_min: svcHint.duration,
        status,
        price_cents: svcHint.price,
        deposit_cents: svcHint.deposit,
        deposit_paid: depositPaid,
        deposit_paid_at: depositPaid ? new Date(day.getTime() - 3 * 86400_000).toISOString() : null,
        balance_paid: balancePaid,
        balance_paid_at: balancePaid ? day.toISOString() : null,
        tip_cents: balancePaid ? faker.number.int({ min: 0, max: 8000 }) : 0,
        source: faker.helpers.arrayElement(['internal', 'public', 'public', 'waitlist']),
        notes: faker.helpers.maybe(() => faker.lorem.sentence({ min: 6, max: 10 }), { probability: 0.3 }) ?? null,
        project_id: projectId,
        session_number: sessionNumber,
        cancelled_at: status === 'cancelled' ? new Date(day.getTime() - 2 * 86400_000).toISOString() : null,
        cancellation_reason:
          status === 'cancelled'
            ? faker.helpers.arrayElement(['client_requested', 'scheduling_conflict', 'illness'])
            : null,
        cancelled_by: status === 'cancelled' ? DEMO_USERS.recept1.id : null,
        consent_required: true,
        consent_signed_at: status === 'completed' ? new Date(day.getTime() - 1 * 3600_000).toISOString() : null,
      })
      bookingIdx++
    }
  }

  // Upsert bookings in chunks of 100 to stay under PostgREST limits
  for (let i = 0; i < bookings.length; i += 100) {
    const chunk = bookings.slice(i, i + 100)
    const { error } = await sb.from('bookings').upsert(chunk, { onConflict: 'id' })
    if (error) throw new Error(`[bookings] bookings upsert chunk ${i}: ${error.message}`)
  }
  log.module('bookings', bookings.length, 'bookings')
  ctx.bookingIds = bookings.map((b) => b.id)
  ctx.completedBookingIds = bookings.filter((b) => b.status === 'completed').map((b) => b.id)

  // 3. Booking photos — 2 per completed booking
  const photoRows: Array<{
    id: string
    studio_id: string
    booking_id: string
    client_id: string
    storage_path: string
    kind: 'reference' | 'before' | 'during' | 'after' | 'healed'
    caption: string | null
    uploaded_by: string
    taken_at: string
  }> = []
  bookings
    .filter((b) => b.status === 'completed')
    .slice(0, 30)
    .forEach((b) => {
      ;(['before', 'after'] as const).forEach((kind) => {
        photoRows.push({
          id: detId('booking_photo', `${b.id}:${kind}`),
          studio_id: ctx.studioId,
          booking_id: b.id,
          client_id: b.client_id,
          storage_path: `booking-photos/demo/${b.id}/${kind}.jpg`,
          kind,
          caption: kind === 'before' ? 'Reference mockup' : 'Session complete',
          uploaded_by: DEMO_USERS.artist1.id,
          taken_at: b.scheduled_at,
        })
      })
    })
  for (let i = 0; i < photoRows.length; i += 100) {
    const chunk = photoRows.slice(i, i + 100)
    const { error } = await sb.from('booking_photos').upsert(chunk, { onConflict: 'id' })
    if (error) throw new Error(`[bookings] booking_photos upsert chunk ${i}: ${error.message}`)
  }
  log.module('bookings', photoRows.length, 'booking_photos')
}

import type { AdminClient } from '../client'
import type { DemoContext } from '../context'
import { asJson, detId, faker, weighted, type Json } from '../rng'
import { log } from '../log'
import { DEMO_USERS } from '../constants'

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  // Fetch booking details needed for payment creation
  const { data: bookings, error: bErr } = await sb
    .from('bookings')
    .select('id, client_id, status, price_cents, deposit_cents, deposit_paid, balance_paid, tip_cents, scheduled_at, deposit_paid_at, balance_paid_at')
    .eq('studio_id', ctx.studioId)
    .in('id', ctx.bookingIds)
  if (bErr) throw new Error(`[payments] booking fetch: ${bErr.message}`)
  if (!bookings) throw new Error('[payments] no bookings found')

  type PaymentType = 'subscription' | 'deposit' | 'balance' | 'tip' | 'refund' | 'adjustment'
  type PaymentStatus = 'pending' | 'processing' | 'succeeded' | 'failed' | 'refunded' | 'partially_refunded'

  type Row = {
    id: string
    studio_id: string
    booking_id: string | null
    client_id: string | null
    dodo_payment_id: string
    type: PaymentType
    amount_cents: number
    currency: string
    status: PaymentStatus
    succeeded_at: string | null
    description: string
    refund_amount_cents: number
    refunded_at: string | null
    refund_reason: string | null
    metadata: Json
  }

  const payments: Row[] = []
  let idx = 0

  // Deposit payments — one per booking with deposit_paid
  for (const b of bookings) {
    if (b.deposit_paid && b.deposit_cents > 0) {
      payments.push({
        id: detId('payment', `deposit:${b.id}`),
        studio_id: ctx.studioId,
        booking_id: b.id,
        client_id: b.client_id,
        dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_dep_${String(idx).padStart(5, '0')}`,
        type: 'deposit',
        amount_cents: b.deposit_cents,
        currency: 'USD',
        status: 'succeeded',
        succeeded_at: b.deposit_paid_at,
        description: `Deposit for booking`,
        refund_amount_cents: 0,
        refunded_at: null,
        refund_reason: null,
        metadata: { demo: true },
      })
      idx++
    }
    // Balance payments — when completed
    if (b.balance_paid && b.price_cents > 0) {
      payments.push({
        id: detId('payment', `balance:${b.id}`),
        studio_id: ctx.studioId,
        booking_id: b.id,
        client_id: b.client_id,
        dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_bal_${String(idx).padStart(5, '0')}`,
        type: 'balance',
        amount_cents: Math.max(0, b.price_cents - b.deposit_cents),
        currency: 'USD',
        status: 'succeeded',
        succeeded_at: b.balance_paid_at,
        description: `Balance for booking`,
        refund_amount_cents: 0,
        refunded_at: null,
        refund_reason: null,
        metadata: { demo: true },
      })
      idx++
    }
    // Tip
    if (b.balance_paid && b.tip_cents && b.tip_cents > 0) {
      payments.push({
        id: detId('payment', `tip:${b.id}`),
        studio_id: ctx.studioId,
        booking_id: b.id,
        client_id: b.client_id,
        dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_tip_${String(idx).padStart(5, '0')}`,
        type: 'tip',
        amount_cents: b.tip_cents,
        currency: 'USD',
        status: 'succeeded',
        succeeded_at: b.balance_paid_at,
        description: `Tip`,
        refund_amount_cents: 0,
        refunded_at: null,
        refund_reason: null,
        metadata: { demo: true },
      })
      idx++
    }
  }

  // 3 failed payments (deposit attempts that failed)
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const b = bookings[bookings.length - 1 - i]!
    payments.push({
      id: detId('payment', `failed:${b.id}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      booking_id: b.id,
      client_id: b.client_id,
      dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_failed_${i}`,
      type: 'deposit',
      amount_cents: b.deposit_cents || 10000,
      currency: 'USD',
      status: 'failed',
      succeeded_at: null,
      description: `Failed deposit attempt`,
      refund_amount_cents: 0,
      refunded_at: null,
      refund_reason: null,
      metadata: { demo: true, failure_code: 'card_declined' },
    })
  }

  // 2 refunded payments (full refund on cancelled bookings)
  const cancelled = bookings.filter((b) => b.status === 'cancelled' && b.deposit_cents > 0).slice(0, 2)
  for (const b of cancelled) {
    payments.push({
      id: detId('payment', `refunded:${b.id}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      booking_id: b.id,
      client_id: b.client_id,
      dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_refunded_${b.id.slice(0, 8)}`,
      type: 'deposit',
      amount_cents: b.deposit_cents,
      currency: 'USD',
      status: 'refunded',
      succeeded_at: new Date(Date.now() - 14 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      description: `Refunded deposit — cancelled booking`,
      refund_amount_cents: b.deposit_cents,
      refunded_at: new Date(Date.now() - 12 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      refund_reason: 'client_requested',
      metadata: { demo: true },
    })
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < payments.length; i += 100) {
    const chunk = payments.slice(i, i + 100)
    const { error } = await sb.from('payments').upsert(chunk, { onConflict: 'id' })
    if (error) throw new Error(`[payments] payments upsert chunk ${i}: ${error.message}`)
  }
  log.module('payments', payments.length, 'payments')
  ctx.paymentIds = payments.map((p) => p.id)

  // Refund requests (2 pending + 1 approved)
  const refundCandidates = bookings.filter((b) => b.status === 'completed').slice(0, 3)
  const refundRows = refundCandidates.map((b, i) => ({
    id: detId('refund_request', b.id),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    booking_id: b.id,
    payment_id: detId('payment', `balance:${b.id}`),
    requested_by: DEMO_USERS.recept1.id,
    amount_cents: Math.floor((b.price_cents || 20000) * 0.5),
    reason: faker.helpers.arrayElement([
      'Client dissatisfied with partial result',
      'Stencil mis-sized',
      'Shop error — scheduling overlap',
    ]),
    status: i === 0 ? ('approved' as const) : i === 1 ? ('pending' as const) : ('processed' as const),
    processed_at: i === 2 ? new Date(Date.now() - 3 * 86400_000).toISOString() : null,
    approver_notes: i === 0 ? 'Approved by owner' : null,
  }))
  const { error: refErr } = await sb.from('refund_requests').upsert(refundRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (refErr) throw new Error(`[payments] refund_requests upsert: ${refErr.message}`)
  log.module('payments', refundRows.length, 'refund_requests')

  // Invoices — 3 past subscription invoices for the studio itself
  const now = new Date()
  const invoiceRows = Array.from({ length: 3 }, (_, i) => {
    const periodStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - (i + 1), 1)
    const periodEnd = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - i, 1)
    return {
      id: detId('invoice', `sub:${i}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      subscription_id: detId('subscription', 'primary'),
      dodo_invoice_id: `inv_demo_${periodStart.toISOString().slice(0, 7)}`,
      dodo_payment_id: `pay_demo_sub_${periodStart.toISOString().slice(0, 7)}`,
      amount_cents: 19900,
      tax_cents: 0,
      currency: 'USD',
      status: 'paid' as const,
      period_start: periodStart.toISOString(),
      period_end: periodEnd.toISOString(),
      paid_at: periodStart.toISOString(),
      line_items: asJson([{ label: 'Enterprise plan — monthly', amount_cents: 19900 }]),
      metadata: asJson({ demo: true }),
    }
  })
  const { error: invErr } = await sb.from('invoices').upsert(invoiceRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (invErr) throw new Error(`[payments] invoices upsert: ${invErr.message}`)
  log.module('payments', invoiceRows.length, 'invoices')

  // Project deposit transactions — ledger entries for projects
  type PDTRow = {
    id: string
    project_id: string
    type: 'received' | 'applied' | 'refunded' | 'consumed'
    amount_cents: number
    method: string | null
    external_id: string | null
    note: string | null
    created_by: string
  }
  const pdtRows: PDTRow[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < ctx.projectIds.length; i++) {
    const projectId = ctx.projectIds[i]!
    pdtRows.push({
      id: detId('pdt', `${projectId}:received`),
      project_id: projectId,
      type: 'received',
      amount_cents: 30000,
      method: 'stripe',
      external_id: `pi_demo_project_${i}`,
      note: 'Initial deposit received',
      created_by: DEMO_USERS.recept1.id,
    })
    pdtRows.push({
      id: detId('pdt', `${projectId}:applied`),
      project_id: projectId,
      type: 'applied',
      amount_cents: 10000,
      method: null,
      external_id: null,
      note: 'Applied to session 1',
      created_by: DEMO_USERS.owner.id,
    })
  }
  // Types for project_deposit_transactions haven't been generated yet — cast to never.
  const { error: pdtErr } = await (sb.from('project_deposit_transactions' as never) as unknown as {
    upsert: (rows: PDTRow[], opts: { onConflict: string }) => Promise<{ error: Error | null }>
  }).upsert(pdtRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (pdtErr) throw new Error(`[payments] project_deposit_transactions upsert: ${pdtErr.message}`)
  log.module('payments', pdtRows.length, 'project_deposit_transactions')

  // Silence unused-var lint from weighted import
  void weighted
}

import type { AdminClient } from '../client'
import type { DemoContext } from '../context'
import { detId, faker, type Json } from '../rng'
import { log } from '../log'

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  const tattooTemplate = ctx.consentTemplateIds[0]!
  const piercingTemplate = ctx.consentTemplateIds[1]!

  // Fetch completed bookings to link consent submissions
  const { data: bookings } = await sb
    .from('bookings')
    .select('id, client_id, scheduled_at')
    .eq('studio_id', ctx.studioId)
    .eq('status', 'completed')
    .in('id', ctx.completedBookingIds.length > 0 ? ctx.completedBookingIds : ['never'])
    .limit(18)

  // 1. Consent form submissions — 15 signed + some pending request rows
  type Sub = {
    id: string
    studio_id: string
    template_id: string
    template_version: number
    template_snapshot: Json
    booking_id: string | null
    client_id: string
    signer_name: string
    signer_email: string | null
    signer_phone: string | null
    answers: Json
    signature_path: string
    signature_svg: string | null
    signed_at: string
    ip_address: string | null
    geo_country: string | null
  }
  const submissions: Sub[] = []
  ;(bookings ?? []).slice(0, 15).forEach((b, i) => {
    const name = faker.person.fullName()
    const firstName = name.split(' ')[0] ?? name
    submissions.push({
      id: detId('consent_submission', b.id),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      template_id: i % 5 === 0 ? piercingTemplate : tattooTemplate,
      template_version: 1,
      template_snapshot: { sections: [] },
      booking_id: b.id,
      client_id: b.client_id,
      signer_name: name,
      signer_email: faker.internet.email({ firstName }).toLowerCase(),
      signer_phone: `+1 415 555 ${String(2000 + i).slice(-4)}`,
      answers: { allergies: 'None disclosed', medications: 'None' },
      signature_path: `consent/demo/${b.id}.svg`,
      signature_svg: '<svg/>',
      signed_at: new Date(new Date(b.scheduled_at).getTime() - 3600_000).toISOString(),
      ip_address: '10.0.0.1',
      geo_country: 'US',
    })
  })
  for (let i = 0; i < submissions.length; i += 50) {
    const chunk = submissions.slice(i, i + 50)
    const { error } = await sb.from('consent_form_submissions').upsert(chunk, { onConflict: 'id' })
    if (error) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_form_submissions upsert chunk ${i}: ${error.message}`)
  }
  log.module('consent', submissions.length, 'consent_form_submissions')

  // 2. Consent form requests — pending requests not yet signed
  const pendingCandidates = ctx.clientIds.slice(15, 22)
  const requestRows = pendingCandidates.map((clientId, i) => ({
    id: detId('consent_request', `${clientId}:${i}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    template_id: tattooTemplate,
    booking_id: null,
    client_id: clientId,
    sent_to_email: `client-${i}@demo.test`,
    status: i === 0 ? ('opened' as const) : ('pending' as const),
    sent_at: new Date(Date.now() - (3 + i) * 86400_000).toISOString(),
    opened_at: i === 0 ? new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 86400_000).toISOString() : null,
    expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
  }))
  const { error: reqErr } = await sb.from('consent_form_requests').upsert(requestRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (reqErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_form_requests upsert: ${reqErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', requestRows.length, 'consent_form_requests')

  // 3. Consent auto-send rules — 3 defaults
  const autoRules = [
    { trigger: 'any_booking' as const, timing: 'immediately' as const, timing_value: 0 },
    { trigger: 'first_time_client' as const, timing: 'hours_before_session' as const, timing_value: 48 },
    { trigger: 'session_complete' as const, timing: 'minutes_after_complete' as const, timing_value: 30 },
  ]
  const autoRows = autoRules.map((r, i) => ({
    id: detId('consent_auto_rule', `${r.trigger}:${i}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    trigger: r.trigger,
    template_id: tattooTemplate,
    timing: r.timing,
    timing_value: r.timing_value,
    channels: ['email', 'sms'] as ('email' | 'sms')[],
    enabled: true,
    is_default: true,
  }))
  const { error: arErr } = await sb.from('consent_auto_send_rules').upsert(autoRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (arErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_auto_send_rules upsert: ${arErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', autoRows.length, 'consent_auto_send_rules')

  // 4. Kiosk session — 1 active
  const { error: kErr } = await sb.from('consent_kiosk_sessions').upsert(
    {
      id: detId('consent_kiosk', 'primary'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      kiosk_token: 'demo-kiosk-token-' + ctx.studioId.slice(0, 8),
      template_id: tattooTemplate,
      enabled: true,
      last_rotated_at: new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
    },
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (kErr) throw new Error(`[consent] consent_kiosk_sessions upsert: ${kErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', 1, 'consent_kiosk_sessions')

  // 5. Studio ink registry — 8 entries (used by REACH)
  const brands = ['Eternal', 'Dynamic', 'World Famous', 'Intenze', 'Fusion', 'Solid', 'Eclipse', 'Quantum']
  const colors = ['True Black', 'Rich Red', 'Ocean Blue', 'Pure White', 'Bold Yellow', 'Forest Green', 'Hot Pink', 'Deep Purple']
  const inkRegistryRows = brands.slice(0, 8).map((brand, i) => ({
    id: detId('studio_ink_registry', `${brand}:${colors[i]}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    brand,
    color: colors[i]!,
    product_code: `${brand.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}-${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    batch_number: `B${new Date().getFullYear()}${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    manufacture_date: new Date(Date.now() - 180 * 86400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    expiry_date: new Date(Date.now() + (365 - i * 30) * 86400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    reach_compliant: i !== 7,  // last one non-compliant for demo
    sds_url: `https://reach-compliance.demo/sds/${brand.toLowerCase()}-${i}.pdf`,
    supplier_id: ctx.supplierIds[i % ctx.supplierIds.length] ?? null,
    is_active: true,
  }))
  const { error: sirErr } = await sb.from('studio_ink_registry').upsert(inkRegistryRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (sirErr) throw new Error(`[consent] studio_ink_registry upsert: ${sirErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', inkRegistryRows.length, 'studio_ink_registry')

  // 6. REACH ink records — link used inks to completed bookings
  const reachRows = (bookings ?? []).slice(0, 8).map((b, i) => {
    const ink = inkRegistryRows[i % inkRegistryRows.length]!
    return {
      id: detId('reach_ink', `${b.id}:${i}`),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      submission_id: detId('consent_submission', b.id),
      booking_id: b.id,
      ink_brand: ink.brand,
      ink_color: ink.color,
      ink_product_code: ink.product_code,
      batch_number: ink.batch_number,
      manufacture_date: ink.manufacture_date,
      expiry_date: ink.expiry_date,
      reach_compliant: ink.reach_compliant,
      reach_compliance_source: (ink.reach_compliant ? 'verified' : 'unverified') as 'verified' | 'artist_claimed' | 'unverified',
      sds_url: ink.sds_url,
      used_at: b.scheduled_at,
    }
  })
  const { error: rErr } = await sb.from('reach_ink_records').upsert(reachRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (rErr) throw new Error(`[consent] reach_ink_records upsert: ${rErr.message}`)
  log.module('consent', reachRows.length, 'reach_ink_records')
}

import type { AdminClient } from '../client'
import type { DemoContext } from '../context'
import { asJson, detId } from '../rng'
import { tolerantUpsert } from '../client'
import { log } from '../log'

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  const now = new Date()

  // 1. Marketing campaigns
  const campaigns = [
    {
      id: detId('campaign', 'april-flash'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      name: 'April Flash Day promo',
      type: 'manual' as const,
      channel: 'email' as const,
      status: 'sent' as const,
      template_subject: 'Flash Day — Saturday, one day only',
      template_body: 'Book a walk-in from our flash sheet. 10% off, Saturday only.',
      audience_filter: asJson({ tags: ['VIP', 'Recurring'] }),
      scheduled_at: new Date(now.getTime() - 14 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      sent_at: new Date(now.getTime() - 14 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      sent_count: 142,
      open_count: 68,
      click_count: 23,
    },
    {
      id: detId('campaign', 'birthday-offer'),
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      name: 'Birthday offer — automated',
      type: 'automated' as const,
      channel: 'both' as const,
      status: 'active' as const,
      template_subject: 'Happy birthday — 15% off your next session',
      template_body: 'We saved a little something for you. Book before the month ends.',
      audience_filter: asJson({ birthday_within_days: 7 }),
      scheduled_at: null,
      sent_count: 28,
      open_count: 18,
      click_count: 6,
    },
  ]
  const { error: cErr } = await tolerantUpsert(sb, 'marketing_campaigns', campaigns, 'id')
  if (cErr) throw new Error(`[marketing] marketing_campaigns upsert: ${cErr.message}`)
  log.module('marketing', campaigns.length, 'marketing_campaigns')

  // 2. Referral codes — 3 codes
  const codes = [
    { code: 'FRIEND15', discount: 15, discountType: 'percentage' as const, reward: 2000, rewardType: 'fixed' as const, clientIdx: 0 },
    { code: 'WELCOME20', discount: 2000, discountType: 'fixed' as const, reward: 0, rewardType: 'fixed' as const, clientIdx: null },
    { code: 'SAM10', discount: 10, discountType: 'percentage' as const, reward: 1500, rewardType: 'fixed' as const, clientIdx: 5 },
  ]
  const codeRows = codes.map((c) => ({
    id: detId('referral_code', c.code),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    client_id: c.clientIdx !== null ? ctx.clientIds[c.clientIdx]! : null,
    code: c.code,
    discount_type: c.discountType,
    discount_value: c.discount,
    referrer_reward_type: c.rewardType,
    referrer_reward_value: c.reward,
    max_uses: 50,
    uses_count: 4,
    is_active: true,
    expires_at: new Date(now.getTime() + 90 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
  }))
  const { error: codeErr } = await sb.from('referral_codes').upsert(codeRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (codeErr) throw new Error(`[marketing] referral_codes upsert: ${codeErr.message}`)
  log.module('marketing', codeRows.length, 'referral_codes')

  // 3. Referral redemptions — 3 applied
  const redemptionRows = Array.from({ length: 3 }, (_, i) => ({
    id: detId('referral_redemption', `${i}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    code_id: codeRows[i % codeRows.length]!.id,
    referrer_client_id: ctx.clientIds[i]!,
    referred_client_id: ctx.clientIds[i + 10]!,
    booking_id: ctx.bookingIds[i]!,
    discount_amount_cents: 3000,
    referrer_reward_cents: 1500,
    status: 'applied' as const,
  }))
  const { error: redErr } = await sb.from('referral_redemptions').upsert(redemptionRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (redErr) throw new Error(`[marketing] referral_redemptions upsert: ${redErr.message}`)
  log.module('marketing', redemptionRows.length, 'referral_redemptions')
}
